abstract: A genetic algorithm is used to drive a deformable mirror and optimize the RF emission from an ultrashort pulse plasma filament. The optimization process increases the plasma volume, linking plasma conductance to RF emission. © 2019 The Author(s).

articleTitle: Electrically Tunable Kerr Combs in Graphene-Nitride Microresonators on-Chip
abstract: Dynamic tuning of soliton Kerr combs is achieved in a graphene actuated silicon nitride microresonator on-chip. Driven by single volt voltage gating, optical dispersion of the microcavity is controlled from −60 to +9 fs<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/mm, enabling broadband tuning of the comb spectrum and diversity of soliton crystal generations. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: All-Fiber Electro-Optic Frequency Comb for Near-Infrared Astronomical Spectrograph Calibration
abstract: A turn-key, all-fiber 14.5 GHz electro-optic modulation-based near-infrared frequency comb spanning 700 nm for astronomical spectrograph calibration is developed, capable of providing radial velocity calibration with a precision of < 10 cm/s, relevant for exoplanet searches. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Bend-Insensitive Through-Fiber Stimulated Emission Depletion (STED) Imaging of HeLa Cells
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, STED images of biological samples where fluorescence has been collected through the same fiber used to transport excitation and depletion light (through-fiber imaging). We also quantitatively demonstrate fiber-bending-independent resolution. These results show promise for endoscopic and in vivo super-resolution imaging.© 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Generation and Detection of Down-converted Photon Pairs at $2.080\ \boldsymbol{\mu} \mathbf{m}$
abstract: We report the generation and coincidence-to-accidental ratio characterization of a pulsed spontaneous parametric down-conversion photon pair source at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2.080\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>, as a basis for free-space quantum communication in an atmospheric window with low solar background.

articleTitle: Measurement of $d$-Coefficients of CdSiP2 Using Non-Phase-Matched Second Harmonic Generation of 2700 to 4700 NM Radiation
abstract: A novel experimental approach, based on re-derivation of the Maker fringe theory, yielded values d<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</inf> and d<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">36</inf> coefficients of CdSiP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> using a picosecond duration laser tuned between 2700 and 4700 nm.

articleTitle: Spatially Coherent Interlayer Exciton Lasing in an Atomically-Thin Heterostructure
abstract: We demonstrate lasing in WSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-MoSe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> heterostructure integrated in a silicon nitride grating cavity. Signatures of lasing include sharp increase in spatial coherence and super-linear increase in the emission intensity as photon number increases above unity. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Power-bandwidth limits in near-field nanophotonics
abstract: We find upper bounds to near-field optical response, for any material over any bandwidth. We apply this approach to CDOS, a photon-entanglement measure, and derive the first general bounds to near-field radiative heat transfer. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Deterministic Positioning of Colloidal Quantum Dots on Silicon Nitride Nanobeam Cavities
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated deterministic positioning of solution processed colloidal quantum dots on a silicon nitride nanobeam resonator, with potential applications in nonlinear optics, multi-functional optical devices, and on-chip, solid-state quantum simulators. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Site-controlled InAs quantum dot for hetero-integration of single photon emitter
abstract: The site-controlled quantum dot was obtained for hetero-integration of single photon emitter with silicon photonic circuit and fiber optics. By using selective-area growth method, the InAs quantum dot was formed on the InP pyramid which showed single photon emission from 1100 to 1300 nm. The hetero-integrated structure was designed as InAs quantum dot on the silicon waveguides with high coupling efficiency and fabricated by micro-transfer technique.

articleTitle: Relative-Phase Synchronization in a Sub-Cycle Parametric Waveform Synthesizer
abstract: We compare two different methods for relative phase synchronization among two channels of a parallel parametric waveform synthesizer. The achieved stability allows for reproducible high-energy sub-cycle pulses capable to generate isolated attosecond pulses without gating. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Reconfigurable mid-infrared optical elements using phase change materials
abstract: Reconfigurable optical elements using the phase change material Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> are demonstrated for freely propagating light as well as phonon polaritons in hexagonal boron nitride. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Trace Gas Sensing through Purcell-Enhanced Raman Scattering in Pressurized Microcavities
abstract: Minimally long microcavities were constructed for Purcell-enhanced Raman scattering in gases at up to 12 bar pressure. A linear emission rate confirms pressure broadening remains exceeded by the cavity linewidth, making pressurization beneficial.

articleTitle: Second-Harmonic Diffraction from Periodically Structured MoS2 Monolayer
abstract: We investigate second-harmonic generation from one-dimensional gratings in Mos2 monolayer flakes structured by focused ion beam milling, and observe diffraction orders due to nonlinear diffraction from the periodic structure. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Improving the Temporal Resolution of Speckle based Remote Phonocardiogram Sensing via Laser Modulation
abstract: We present a method for remote phonocardiogram sensing which employs temporal modulation of the illumination laser. This method yields a significant enhancement of the temporal bandwidth of the captured speckle image sequence, thus improving performance.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Few-Cycle Pulse Laser-induced Damage and Ablation of HfO2/SiO2-based Optical Thin Films
abstract: Few-cycle pulse laser damage and ablation of HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-based single-, double-, and quad-layer thin films are studied using time-resolved surface microscopy. Ablation of multilayer samples happens as fast as for the single-layer, indicating a “blow-out” mechanism. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Cascade-Linked Multi-Synthetic-Wavelength Digital Holography Using Line-by-Line Spectral Shaping Optical Frequency Comb
abstract: Line-by-line spectral shaping of a 10-GHz optical frequency comb (OFC) is used for cascade-linked multi-synthetic-wavelength digital holography. The proposed method enables the real-time 3D shape measurement with wide axial dynamic range.© 2019 The Author <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{s})$</tex>

articleTitle: Chipscale Soliton Microcombs
abstract: Optical frequency combs provide equidistant frequency markers and have applications that encompass fundamental Physics to Engineering. This tutorial will review the fundamental operational principles and latest development in the field of soliton microresonators frequency combs (micro-combs). Such microcombs provide a chipscale, compact source of coherent and broadband frequency combs, at low power and have been applied to realize chipscale frequency synthesizers, optical clocks, and applied to LIDAR, dual comb spectroscopy, microwave photonics, as well as astrophysical spectometer calibration. They utilize spatio-temporal self organization of light in the form of dissipative solitons. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-Sensitivity X-Ray Optical Cross-Correlator for Next Generation Free-Electron Lasers
abstract: We designed a novel X-ray arrival time monitor that cross-correlates X-ray and 1550 nm optical pulses used in state-of-the-art femtosecond timing distribution systems. We exploit an interferometric detection scheme and etalon effects in thin-film Germanium to achieve unprecedented high sensitivity to soft X-rays. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Plasmonic photo-thermo-electric effect in graphene
abstract: We present a novel photo-thermo-electric effect in graphene photo-detectors established by hot electrons concentration gradients at plasmonic contacts. Our description is crucial for an in depth understanding of graphene-based photo detection devices. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Gain-Optimized 2.05 μm Pulses at 20 mJ and 1 kHz from Multi-Pass Ho: YLF Amplifier
abstract: We present Ho:YLF based multi-pass amplifier emitting pulses at 20 mJ energy and 1 kHz repetition rate seeded by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3-\mu \mathrm{J}$</tex> seed pulses from DC-OPA. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: On Speckle Intensity Correlations Over Object Position
abstract: A general theory for intensity correlations over object position allows an arbitrary object to be imaged through an amount of scatter limited by detector noise. Applications include in vivo imaging, material inspection, and environmental sensing. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Helicity in a Twist: Attosecond, Extreme Ultraviolet Vortex Beams with Designer Spin and Orbital Angular Momenta
abstract: High-harmonies-and attosecond pulses-with controllable spin and orbital angular momenta (SAM and OAM) are generated for the first time. The coupled SAM-OAM conservation laws enable exquisite control over the polarization of attosecond pulse trains. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Generation of surface plasmonic resonance mode on highly ordered diverse conformation of Au nanostructures
abstract: Three different shapes of Au nanostructures, which are cone, embossed, and wave-like shapes, were fabricated with a high order based on an anodized aluminum oxide (AAO) template and utilized for surface-enhanced Raman scattering system. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Photonic Recurrent Ising Sampler
abstract: We present the Photonic Recurrent Ising Sampler (PRIS), an algorithm tailored for photonic parallel networks, that can sample distributions of arbitrary Ising problems. The PRIS finds the ground state of general Ising problems and probes critical exponents of universality classes. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Multiplicity of Laser-Excited Electromagnetic Modes and Their Roles in LIPSS Formation on Thin Metallic Films
abstract: Two types of laser-induced periodic surface structures produced by ultrashort laser pulses on Cr films of different thickness have been created and explained, based on a rigorous model of plasmon polaritons and dynamics of oxidation. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Tensorial Shear Stress Sensing Using Elliptically-Shaped Nanopillar Light-Emitting Diodes
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a tensorial shear stress sensor capableof detecting both the magnitude and direction of the stress using an array of elliptically-shaped nanopillar GaN light-emitting diodes.

articleTitle: Robust Cell Imaging Through Anderson Localizing Optical Fiber based on Deep Learning
abstract: Robust artifact-free cell imaging is demonstrated by combing a meter-long Anderson localizing optical fiber with deep learning using incoherent illumination. The tolerance to fiber bending can reach ∼3 degrees for high-fidelity cell-image transport. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Deterministic Single Soliton Generation without Frequency Tuning in a Graphene-FP Microresonator
abstract: A novel microresonator based on Fabry–Pérot resonator and monolayer graphene has been proposed. This design allows deterministic single soliton generation without frequency tuning and has strong robustness under frequency and timing jitter.

articleTitle: Joint Blind Equalization of CD and RSOP Using Kalman Filter in Stokes Vector Direct Detection System
abstract: We propose a joint blind equalization for CD and RSOP in SV-DD system based on new Kalman structure, which has strong tolerance to CD (more than 2550 ps/nm) combined with ultra-fast RSOP (up to 2Mrad/s). © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Robust, High Peak Power, Thulium-Doped Fiber Chirped-Pulse Amplification System Using a Dissipative Soliton Seed Laser
abstract: We report a dissipative soliton seeded, thulium-doped fiber chirped pulse amplification system at 1950 nm. The amplified pulses are compressed to 545 fs and have an energy of 0.85 uJ corresponding peak power of 1.56 MW. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Doppler Detection of Pathogenic Activity in Living Tissue by Biodynamic Imaging
abstract: Bacterial infection of living tissue is monitored by biodynamic imaging based on intracellular Doppler fluctuation spectroscopy. The efficacy of pathogen suppression by antibiotics may enable detection of antibiotic resistant strains in vitro. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Scaling of Mode Degeneracy and Image Fidelity in a Self-Imaging Optical Resonator
abstract: Nonlinear optical processing of images in a miniature self-imaging cavity holds enormous potential for optical information processing and artificial neural networks. We analyze the inherent trade-off between the cavity size, image amplification, and image fidelity. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Over 2W Room Temperature Lasing on a Large Area Photonic Crystal Quantum Cascade Laser
abstract: We present a large-area (1.5 mm × 1.5 mm) photonic crystal quantum cascade laser, with over 2 W peak power at room temperature (289 K), and symmetrical, narrow (< 1°), single-lobed surface-emitting beam. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Probing Ultrafast, Shock-Induced Chemistry Using Extremely Broad Band, Ultrashort Mid-Infrared Pulses
abstract: Using extremely broad-band mid-infrared pulses ($3-14\ \mu \text{m}$), and a single shot spectrometer, we probe ultrafast chemistry at high pressures (∼20 GPa) through changes in the vibrational spectrum. Here we present results on shocked benzene and nitromethane.

articleTitle: Mid-Infrared 2-D Beam Steering
abstract: We will experimentally demonstrate optical beam steering in the mid-IR spectral region (around λ=4.6µm) in the InP/InGaAs platform. Both wavelength and phase tuning are utilized for two-dimensional (2D) steering in elevation and azimuthal directions respectively. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Fabrication and Characterization of Birefringent Bismuth and Erbium Co-Doped Photonic Crystal Fiber for Broadband Polarized Near Infrared Emission
abstract: Birefringent bismuth and erbium co-doped photonic crystal fiber (B-BEPCF) by preform stacking technology has been fabricated and characterized. Results demonstrate broadband and elliptically polarized near infrared (NIR) emission under 532 or 830 nm pumping, respectively.

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated K-Band Microwave Oscillator based on Silicon Nitride Soliton Microcomb
abstract: Using photonic integrated silicon nitride microresonators of quality factor exceeding 15 million, we demonstrate 19-GHz-repetition-rate single soliton with 35 mW optical power, and characterize the phase noise of the repetition rate in the K-band microwave regime.© 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Low-Order Harmonic Generation in Mid-Infrared Laser Filaments in Gases
abstract: We detect up to 11<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>-order harmonics generated through filamentation of ultrashort laser pulses at 3.9µm wavelength in air and argon. Harmonic's spectra map the nonlinear evolution of the mid-infrared driver and exhibit CEP-denendent spectral interference. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Deep Learning Enables Virtual Histological Staining of Label-Free Tissue Sections Using Auto-Fluorescence
abstract: We report a data-driven method for label-free virtual histological staining of tissue sections using deep learning. This framework is successfully demonstrated by inferring multiple types of stains on different tissue types using auto-fluorescence signal. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Extreme Nonlinear Optics with Dielectric Metasurfaces
abstract: We use dielectric metasurfaces made from direct bandgap semiconductors to generate high-harmonics and nonlinear mixing simultaneously, without the need of phase matching. Inclusion of broken-symmetry designs and quantum heterostructures can lead to even higher efficiencies.

articleTitle: Pseudo-Magnetic Monopole and Antimonopole in PT-Symmetric Coupled Waveguides
abstract: $\mathscr{PT}$-symmetric coupled waveguides, for which the Berry curvature corresponds to a hyperbolic pseudo-magnetic monopole or antimonopole, are shown to have a purely imaginary Berry connection, which can induce gain and loss when it is non-periodic.

articleTitle: Photon-Level Tuning of a High-Q Lithium Niobate Photonic Crystal Nanocavity
abstract: We report an all-optical approach for extremely efficient tuning of a high-Q lithium niobate photonic crystal nanocavity, with a significant resonance tuning rate of 110 MHz/photon. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 3D surface profile imaging based on time-encoded structured illumination
abstract: A novel 3D surface profile imaging method based on time-encoded structured illumination is proposed. With fast and arbitrary illumination pattern generation, low error 3D reconstruction of different objects can be obtained. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Functional Pulsed Fiber Lasers for Multicolor Stimulated Raman Scattering Microscopy
abstract: I present our development of picosecond pulsed fiber laser sources for realizing highperformance yet practical molecular-vibrational microscopy based on stimulated Raman scattering. Specifically, I introduce a fast wavelength-tunable pulse source and an ultralow-intensity-noise oscillator. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Pulse Sequence for Nearly Single-Cycle Terahertz Pulse Generation in Aperiodically Poled Lithium Niobate
abstract: We show that high-power nearly single-cycle THz-pulse can be generated in aperiodically poled lithium niobate crystal pumped by pulse-position modulated sequence of femtosecond laser pulses. A closed form expression for the pulse shape is obtained. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Direct Detection of Quantum Phase Errors in Spatially Multiplexed Transmission Channels
abstract: We introduce a protocol for direct detection of arbitrary continuous phase errors in transmission of multi-photon spatially entangled quantum states, and present a design and experimental evidence for its realization in an integrated photonic circuit. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Plasmonic stripes integrated in a silicon nitride Mach Zehnder Interferometer for high sensitivity refractometric sensors
abstract: We demonstrate an interferometric plasmo-photonic sensor based on Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> photonic waveguides and gold Surface Plasmon Polariton waveguides. The proposed approach exhibits bulk sensitivity up to 1930 nm/RIU, holding promise for compact and ultra-sensitive interferometric sensing devices. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultrafast Photoluminescence Without Phonon Scattering Due to Nonlocal Light-Matter Interaction
abstract: Ultrafast radiative recombination of confined excitons in a semiconductor mesoscopic thin film has been investigated by temperature dependence of photoluminescence spectra. Sub-100 fs radiative decay competes with phonon scattering even at room temperature.

articleTitle: Near-Ultraviolet Dielectric Metasurfaces for Surface-Enhanced Circular Dichroism Spectroscopy and Handedness-Preserved Reflection
abstract: We report a design of achiral dielectric metasurfaces that can enhance the circular dichroism of chiral molecules by over 50 times and preserve the spin states of light upon reflection in the near-ultraviolet region.

articleTitle: Time-Resolved Dual Frequency Comb Spectroscopy for Broadband Multi-Species Detection in Laser-Induced Plasmas
abstract: We present the first results using time-resolved broadband dual-comb spectroscopy in a laser-induced plasma. Preliminary results identifying multiple species in a Nd magnet will be shown. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Coherent Interaction of Light with a Single Molecule and a Plasmonic Nanoparticle
abstract: We demonstrate partial cloaking of a gold nanoparticle by a single organic molecule as a result of their coherent interaction with a monochromatic laser beam at cryogenic temperatures. Spectral and fluorescence lifetime analyses are presented.© 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultrafast Photocurrents in the Weyl Semimetal TaAs
abstract: Terahertz emission from TaAs reveals highly directional, ultrafast photocurrents whose origin is intrinsically due to crystal structure. This is illustrated by unraveling the polarization dependence, directionality, and intrinsic timescales underlying photocurrent generation and decay. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Graphene Mode-Locked Tm,Ho:CLNGG Laser with 70-FS Pulse Duration
abstract: We report on a mode-locked Tm,Ho:CLNGG laser employing graphene as a saturable absorber. Pulses as short as 70 fs, i.e., 10 optical cycles, are generated at 2093 nm with a repetition rate of ~89 MHz. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-Power, Widely-Tunable Femtosecond Cylindrical Vector Beam Optical Parametric Oscillator
abstract: We propose a cylindrical vector beam optical parametric oscillator, which is capable of delivering on demand vector beam tunable across 1405~1601 nm directly, with a maximum power of 614 mW at 1505 nm. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Adiabatic transitions between supersymmetric structures as a tool to design integrated photonic devices
abstract: We introduce adiabatic transitions between supersymmetric structures as a systematic way to engineer efficient and robust integrated photonic devices by modifying the refractive index profile along the propagation direction. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Tailored generation, manipulation, and application of photonic temporal modes
abstract: Pulsed temporal modes form a high-dimensional basis for quantum information applications. By controlling these modes, we can tailor quantum states and measurements for applications such as quantum state tomography or quantum metrology.

articleTitle: Slow cooking of SNAP microresonators
abstract: We demonstrate a SNAP microresonator permanently introduced at the silica microcapillary by multi-hour heating with hot water from the inside. The discovered effect is presumably caused by water-induced irreversible processes within the micron-scale silica thickness. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Coherent Atomic Microwave Sensor
abstract: We developed a room-temperature atomic microwave sensor that converts coherently a low-power microwave signal to polarization modulation of a probe light field. The sensitivity rivals that of microwave field probes based on Rydberg atoms.

articleTitle: High-Quality Lithium Niobate Optomechanical Crystal
abstract: We demonstrate 1D lithium niobate optomechanical crystal with 1550 nm optical mode with quality factor 300,000 and 1.9 GHz mechanical mode with quality factor 37,000 at 4 Kelvin. The optomechanical coupling rate is measured to be <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{g}_{0}=2\pi\times120$</tex> kHz. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Beyond Metals and Semiconductors: Nano-Oxides for Nonlinear Photonic Devices
abstract: I will show several strategies to maximize nonlinear optical signals in oxide-based materials with noncentrosymmetric crystalline structure, because of their wide bandgap, significant second-order optical nonlinearities, strong electro-optic effects, high damage threshold, and biocompatibility. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 50Gb/S CVD Graphene-Insulator-Graphene Electro-Absorption Modulator on Si Waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate a non-return to zero optical modulation at 50Gb/s with a CVD grown Graphene-Insulator-Graphene electro-absorption modulator integrated on a Si photonic waveguide. The device exhibits a 3dB electro-optical bandwidth of 30GHz. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Broadband Efficient Soliton Microcombs in Pulse-Driven Photonic Microresonators
abstract: Broadband single-soliton based frequency combs, with a detectable repetition rate of 28 GHz, are efficiently generated through pulse-driving of a chip-based Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microresonator. We observe an influence of the pulse-driving rate on the comb mode linewidth. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband Nonlinear Optics in Dispersion Engineered Periodically Poled Lithium Niobate Waveguides
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the first generation of dispersion-engineered periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) waveguides. These waveguides achieve ultra-broadband second-harmonic generation (SHG) and multi-octave supercontinuum generation (SCG) with record-low pulse energies. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Acousto-Optical Receivers Based on Optomechanical Resonance and Oscillation
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that radiation pressure based optomechanical interaction in high-Q cavities can be exploited for high sensitivity acousto-optical transduction and direct signal down-conversion in underwater ultrasonic communication links and sensor networks.

articleTitle: Atomic Cladded Waveguide for Chip Scale Stabilization and Modulation of Telecom Wavelengths
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a chip-scale integration of photonic waveguides and alkali vapor for frequency reference and modulation. A telecom signal was stabilized to rubidium ladder transition and was modulated by a 780nm pump laser. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Lithography-Free Hybrid Ag-Au Super Absorbing Metasurfaces for Addictive Drug Sensing
abstract: We demonstrate a lithography-free super absorbing metasurface consisting of hybrid Ag-Au nanoantennas with sub-20-nm nanogaps for surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy sensing to tackle the emerging drug-abuse challenge. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal-Enhanced Fluorescence Imaging of Cardiovascular Biomarker with Machine Learning Analysis
abstract: A photonic crystal-enhanced fluorescence imaging immunoassay biosensor is capable of detecting NT-proBNP as a cardiovascular biomarker at various concentrations. Utilizing machine-learning algorithms, we create a predictive model for the analyte quantification. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Spin Coherence in Single NV Centers Coupled to Controllably Assembled Nanopatch Antennas
abstract: We transfer a pre-characterized nanodiamond with a single nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center onto an epitaxial silver substrate and deterministically couple it to a nanopatch antenna. The NV retains its coherent spin dynamics in this process. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Rapid and Precise Displacement Measurement Using Time-of-Flight Detection of Femtosecond Optical Pulses
abstract: We demonstrate high-speed and high-resolution displacement measurement method by utilizing electro-optic sampling between electrical pulses from photodetection and femtosecond optical pulses. A 5.8-nm (1.9-nm) resolution is achieved in only 50 μs (14 ms) update time. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Characterization of small-scale contortions on a physical-surface using a distributed optical-fiber sensor
abstract: We use spatially continuous measurements of the Bragg-wavelength of a grating in an offset-core fiber to measure continuous, sub-millimeter length-scale variations on the surface of a corrugated metal surface.

articleTitle: All-Optical Hilbert Transform with Optical Frequency Comb for One-Shot Three-Dimensional Imaging
abstract: A novel all-optical Hilbert transform with precise relative carrier-phase and envelope control utilizing frequency control of an optical frequency comb is reported. One-shot three-dimensional imaging of a surface profile demonstrated 200-square-pixels resolution and urn-level uncertainty. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optical Information Processing with Noise-Resistant Entangled Topological States
abstract: Linear-optical photonic quantum walks are used to jointly entangle polarization and winding number. This joint entanglement allows polarization entanglement-based quantum information processing tasks to be performed with high degree or error protection. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Locking CW laser to ultra-stable optical frequency comb by feed-forward method
abstract: We report a precision feed-forward locking between a 1064 nm CW laser and an ultra-stable frequency comb. The relative linewidth of the 1064nm CW laser is 1.14 mHz and the stability reaches <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.5\times 10^{-17}/\mathrm{s}$</tex>. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Hydrodynamics and Spatio-Temporal Mapping of Oxide Formation in Laser-Produced U Plasmas
abstract: We combine optical emission spectroscopy with hydrodynamic measurements in laser-produced uranium plasma in air to detect formation of higher uranium oxide states. Generation of uranium oxides reduces the excited atomic uranium population. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Solving the Untrusted Source Problem in Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: We propose a light source monitoring scheme to solve the untrusted source problem in measurement-device-independent quantum key distribution, and show it performs almost the same as the initial protocol with a trusted source. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Multiwavelength Neuromorphic Photonics
abstract: Neuromorphic photonics promises orders of magnitude improvements in both speed and energy efficiency over digital electronics. We will give an overview of neuromorphic photonic systems and their application to optimization and machine learning problems. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Nd:Y2O3 Transparent Ceramics: Fabrication and Laser Performance
abstract: 0.6 at% Nd:Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> transparent ceramics with high optical quality were fabricated by vacuum sintering plus hot isostatic pressing. High efficiency CW laser operation at 1.08 and 1.36 µm were demonstrated. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Toward quantum microwave to optical conversion using rare earth ion containing crystals
abstract: With an Er:Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> crystal at 4 K we achieve microwave to optical conversion with quantum efficiency 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup>. Theory and initial results at milli-kelvin temperatures and with fully concentrated rare earth crystals point to significant improvements. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Er-and Tm-Doped Mode-Locked Fiber Laser with a Broadband, Microfiber-Based MOF Saturable Absorber
abstract: We demonstrate mode-locked pulse generation in erbium-doped and thulium-doped fiber lasers by using a microfiber-based metal-organic frameworks saturable absorber. Our results highlight the applicability of such nanomaterial as a broadband SA for ultrafast photonic applications. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Broadband Brillouin-based Phase Shifter with Phase Amplification in a Silicon Waveguide
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a broadband silicon phase shifter based on Brillouin scattering. We have achieved a 360° phase shift over a 15 GHz bandwidth with a phase amplification factor of 25.7 using only 1.5 dB gain. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Bending-Induced Tunable Threshold in Random Laser
abstract: We investigate the case that the transport mean free path of emitted photons within the disordered scatterers, which is composed by the ZnO nanowires, is tunable by a curvature bending applied on the flexible polyethylene terephthalate substrate underneath, thereby creating a unique light source which is able to be operated above and below the lasing threshold for desirable spectral emissions. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Three-element-cavity enables Kerr-lens mode-locking at 20-GHz repetition rate
abstract: We propose a new cavity design for a compact Kerr-lens mode-locked laser using only three optical elements. The repetition rate of 20 GHz was achieved with the pulse duration of 120 fs. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Quantum illumination with x-rays
abstract: We present the experimental realization of quantum illumination with x-rays. By using entangled photons, we detected the presence of an object in a noisy environment and improved the visibility substantially compared to classical methods. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Avoidance of Cross-Phase Modulation in Femtosecond Stimulated Raman Scattering
abstract: The influence of cross-phase modulation on stimulated Raman scattering in the high peak power regime is investigated, resulting in optimized pulse parameters for reduced cross-phase modulation artefacts.

articleTitle: Interfacing solid-state single-photon sources and integrated photonics circuits: high rate three-photon coalescence
abstract: We report the interfacing of an integrated solid-state single-photon source with an integrated, reconfigurable photonic tritter demonstrating a highly efficient quantum interference of three indistinguishable single photons. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Coherent Virtual Absorption and Embedded Eigenstates in non-Hermitian $\mathcal{PT}$-Symmetrical Systems
abstract: The recently emerged concepts of coherent perfect absorption (CPA), i.e., the time-reversed counterpart of a laser and its generalization to Hermitian systems, coherent virtual absorption (CVA), are shown to be ideally suited for all-optical light manipulation. In this work, we demonstrate how the concept of coherent excitation can pave the way to light scattering control in an extreme fashion in non-Hermitian <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathcal{PT}$</tex> -symmetrical systems supporting an embedded eigenstate. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Above-Octave Supercontinuum Generation in a Hybrid Nonlinear Waveguide for On-Chip Cascaded Third- and Second-Order Nonlinear-Optic Applications
abstract: It is shown that over 1.25 octaves supercontinuum is attainable in a hybrid chalcogenide-glass/lithium-niobate miniaturized waveguide platform that allows cascaded third- and second-order optical nonlinearities on a monolithic chip, particularly for frequency-stabilized integrated comb sources.

articleTitle: Waveguide Coupling of an Integrated Nanowire Laser on Silicon with Enhanced End-Facet Reflectivity
abstract: We numerically explored the coupling characteristics and the critical interplay with the end-facet reflectivities of nanowire lasers coupled to proximal silicon-waveguides. A proper waveguide design enables high coupling efficiencies with enhanced end-facet reflectivities of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim$</tex> 83%. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Classical to Quantum Transitions in Multilayer Plasmonic Metamaterials
abstract: We demonstrate that classical-to-quantum transition of free electron plasma can be used to as a doping-independent parameter controlling optical topology of metamaterials and present a comprehensive description of this phenomenon. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Mode-locked Topological Laser in Synthetic Dimensions
abstract: We present topological insulator laser with one spatial and one modal dimensions. The topological lasing state imposes constant phase difference between the multi-frequency modes, forcing the resonators to mode-lock and emit short pulses. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Germanium-Tin Semiconductors for Silicon-Compatible Mid-Infrared Photonics
abstract: GeSn alloys have recently been the subject of extensive investigations as a new platform to engineer the band structure and directness in group IV semiconductors thus providing a rich playground to implement silicon-compatible photonics and optoelectronics. Herein, we discuss the growth of these metastable semiconductors and their use in a variety of silicon-compatible devices. We will also discuss the effects of strain and Sn content on the optical, electronic, and structural properties of Sn-rich group IV semiconductors. Comments and questions should be directed to the OSA Conference Papers staff (tel: + 1 202.416.6191, e-mail: cstech@osa.org). © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Tunable Photonic RF Bandpass Filters Based on an 80 Channel Kerr Micro-Comb Source
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable photonic RF bandpass filter based on a Kerr micro-comb source providing 80 taps in the C-band. We achieve a widely tunable centre frequency (0.05FSR<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">RF</inf>~0.40FSR<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">RF</inf>) and 3-dB bandwidth (0.5 ~ 4.6 GHz). © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Experimental observation of multi-atom Dicke states in an atomic vapor using optical 2D coherent spectroscopy
abstract: We report the first observation of two-, three-, four-, five-, six-, and seven-atom Dicke states in an atomic vapor using optical multi-quantum 2D coherent spectroscopy. This has significant implications in the studies of many-body physics. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: New Resonance Behavior Based on Bound States in the Continuum in a Silicon Photonic Waveguide Platform
abstract: A new type of resonance in silicon photonics is demonstrated, achieved by coupling between a continuum of TE slab modes to a discrete TM mode of a silicon ridge to create a single sharp resonance. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Dual-wavelength Terahertz Metalens Based on Geometric Phase Metasurface
abstract: We proposed a novel dual-wavelength meta-atom, which could be used to independently modulate the geometric phase of the circularly polarized incident wave at two terahertz frequencies. A prototype dual-wavelength metalens has been designed and verified at the terahertz regime. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Extreme Nonlinear Optics in Two Dimensional Materials
abstract: We show recent progress of extreme non-linear optics in two dimensional materials. High-harmonic generation is confirmed not only in semiconductors but also metals under irradiation of mid-infrared femtosecond laser pulses. We found main mechanism changes according to the carrier doping status of the material.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Space-Time Wave Packets That Travel in Optical Materials at the Speed of Light in Vacuum
abstract: We synthesize optical wave packets that travel in transparent non-dispersive materials (liquids, glasses, and sapphire) at the speed of light in vacuum, independently of the refractive index, by introducing carefully designed spatio-temporal field spectral correlations.

articleTitle: Athermal Operation of Multi-Section PIC
abstract: Energy-efficient athermal bias current procedures based on thermal-tuning is demonstrated for a PIC composed of 2 lasers in a master-slave configuration, achieving mode-hop free wavelength stability of 750 MHz over a temperature range 10–60 °C.

articleTitle: Transparent Diffraction Gratings Using Silicon Nanowire Arrays Embedded in Flexible Polymer
abstract: Two dimensional diffraction gratings was demonstrated by using vertical silicon nanowire arrays in transparent and flexible polymer. The high order diffraction was observed by controlling their shapes of the silicon nanowire arrays.

articleTitle: Non-linear optics and harmonic generation in ZnS using femtosecond mid-IR pulses near zero dispersion wavelength
abstract: Using intense <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.6\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>, 200 fs, 500 Hz laser pulses, non-linear spectral broadening, filamentation and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-9<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonic generation in ZnS (Cleartran™) with 3–40 mm propagation distance were observed. Non-linear index of Cleartran was also measured. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Spectrally Selective Detection with In2O3/n-Si Radial Heterojunction Nanowire Photodiodes
abstract: We demonstrated radial heterojunction nanowire photodiodes consisting of an In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-shell/Si-core structure using conformal coating of an In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> layer on n-Si nanowires. We achieve selective spectral response from 400 to 700 nm by tuning the nanowire diameter. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Modelling of a Deep Space FSO-Link with a SNSPD Receiver Unit Under Turbulence-Induced Fading Conditions
abstract: Performance of a deep space FSO-link incorporating SNSPD parametrized with deadtime, QE and N-array is addressed. Considering atmospheric turbulence fading ≤3.5 dB, data rate up to 20 Mbps for −17 (ph/ns)[dB] received signal is reached. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Atom Probe Tomography with Extreme-Ultraviolet Light
abstract: We have adapted an atom probe tomograph (APT) with an extreme ultraviolet (EUV) source. The EUV photon energies open a direct photoionization pathway unavailable in conventional near-UV APT. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optical Frequency Measurements with a Silica Disk Microcomb
abstract: Aspects of reliable chip-scale frequency combs are discussed. A silica disk microcomb operating at 15 GHz and broadened in a silicon nitride waveguide is used to measure the frequency drift between two ultrastable reference lasers. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Time-Domain Vectorial Field Reconstruction of a Circularly Polarized Harmonic from Silicon Using 2D Spectral Shearing Interferometry
abstract: A two-dimensional spectral shearing interferometry is demonstrated permitting to reconstruct vectorial optical fields with picojoule energy. As proof of principle, we retrieve the circularly polarized third-harmonic field emitted from 2-μm-thin silicon driven by 2.1-μm pulses. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Subcycle dynamics of ionization revealed via polarization of lowest harmonics
abstract: We show that by looking at the polarization of lowest (0th and 3d) harmonics of the atomic response it is possible to determine details of attosecond-scale ionization dynamics including ionization time and its temporal asymmetry. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Two-phase flow monitoring with an electrical-optical probe
abstract: An electrical-optical probe was developed to monitor monophasic and biphasic flow in industrial environments. The probe measures the parameters of electrical conductance and mechanical strain, thereby introducing data redundancy and facilitating auto calibration. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Observing Quantum Turbulent Structure in Laser Speckle
abstract: We demonstrate both experimentally and numerically that vortices in laser speckle obey the same velocity statistics as in turbulent quantum fluids, thus linking the seemingly-disparate fields of classical optics and quantum fluid dynamics. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: ITO Mach-Zehnder Modulator on Si
abstract: We demonstrate a monolithically integrated compact ITO electro-optic modulator in silicon photonics based on a Mach-Zehnder interferometer featuring a high-performance half-wave voltage and active device length product of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$V\pi d=0.59\mathrm{V}$</tex>.mm. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 1.94 GHz Passively Harmonic Mode-Locked All-Fiber Laser Using Polarization-Maintaining Helical Long-Period Grating
abstract: We have demonstrated an all-fiber passively harmonic mode-locked laser by using helical long-period grating inscribed in polarization-maintaining fiber for the first time. 1.94 GHz pulses at 63<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> harmonic with 49.5dB super-mode suppression ratio are obtained.

articleTitle: Optical Characterization of Single Tin-Vacancy Centers in Diamond Nanopillars
abstract: We characterize the optical and spin properties of tin-vacancy centers isolated in diamond nanopillars. We measure spectrometer-limited linewidths < 15 GHz, a strong polarization dependence of the emission, and Zeeman splitting behavior consistent with previous theoretical predictions. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Solving Large-Scale NP-Complete Problem with an Optical Solver Driven by a Dual-Comb ‘Clock’
abstract: A scheme using a simple dual-comb fiber laser to solve large instance NP-C problems is demonstrated based on asynchronous sampling measurement of pulse delays through a fiber network, and picosecond resolution, nanosecond range are achieved.

articleTitle: 104 FS Mode-Locked Fiber Laser with a MXENE-Based Saturable Absorber
abstract: We report an all-fiber erbium-doped laser mode-locked by a microfiber-based MXene saturable absorber, generating 104-fs pulses with 42.5-nm spectral width. Our work adds MXene to the growing catalogue of nanomaterials for future nonlinear photonics.

articleTitle: Resonant, High-Frequency Acousto-Optic Modulators (AOM) Fabricated in a MEMS Foundry Platform
abstract: We report the design and characterization of high frequency, resonant acousto-optic modulators in a MEMS foundry process. The doubly-resonant cavity design allows us to measure acousto-optic modulation at frequencies upto 4 GHz with high modulation efficiency <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{V}_{\pi}\approx 350\text{mV}, \mathrm{f}_{res}\approx 2 \text{GHz})$</tex>. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Voltage controlled fine-structure splitting of single photon emitters in a two-dimensional semiconductor
abstract: We report on the modulation of the fine-structure splitting (FSS) of quantum dot-like emitters in a two-dimensional semiconductor. Voltage-controlled suppression of the electron-hole exchange interaction features a 40% increase in circular polarization with decreasing FSS. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: LT-GaAs-based photomixers with > 2 mW peak output power in the 220–325 GHz frequency band
abstract: It is shown in this communication that a LT-GaAs photomixer based on an optically resonant cavity is able to generate peak output powers above 2 mW in the 220–325 GHz frequency band. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Efficient High-power Single-mode Yb Three-level Cladding-pumped All-solid Photonic Bandgap Fiber Lasers at ~978nm
abstract: We report an efficiency of 62.7% with regard to the launched pump from a Yb cladding-pumped fiber laser at ~978nm. ~84W with an M2 of 1.11/1.12 was achieved, a significant improvement from a flexible fiber.© 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Robust compressive imaging through single multimode fiber with millimeter depth of field against bending
abstract: Single pixel imaging experiment through single multimode fiber demonstrates capability of multi-millimeter depth of field, almost three orders larger than previous work, also robustness against fiber configuration change caused by bending. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Stability Self-Injection Locked Laser
abstract: We demonstrate a miniature self-injection locked 1550 nm laser characterized with Allan deviation of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup> at 1s integration time. The stability is achieved using a composite crystalline monolithic optical resonator. The thermal stabilization on the order of 10 μK at 1s is achieved using a standard thermo-electric element. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Polarization-Dependent Optical Binding of Plasmonic Nanoparticles
abstract: Plasmonic metal nanoparticles can self-assemble into anisotropic chains in a linearly polarized optical field and ordered hexagonal arrays in a circularly polarized optical field. Negativc optical toraue can be observed in the arrays. © 2019 The Author(s)

abstract: The following topics are dealt with: high-speed optical techniques; silicon; integrated optics; optical waveguides; elemental semiconductors; III-V semiconductors; nanophotonics; optical resonators; quantum optics; optical pumping.

abstract: Plenary Sessions and Awards Ceremony information.

articleTitle: High-Power Wide-Bandwidth $1.55-{\mu} \mathbf{m}$ Directly Modulated DFB Lasers for Free Space Optical Communications
abstract: Single-mode directly modulated distributed feedback (DFB) lasers working at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.55-\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> with high power of 160 mW output, SMSR beyond 50 dB and large bandwidth of 8.5 GHz are demonstrated. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 60m/2.5Gbps Underwater Optical Wireless Communication with NRZ-OOK Modulation and Digital Nonlinear Equalization
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 2.5Gbps communication system based on a 450nm laser over 60m underwater transmission distance at the BER level of 3.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> by using NRZ-OOK modulation and digital nonlinear equalization technology. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Integrated-Phased-Array-Based Visible-Light Near-Eye Holographic Projector
abstract: An integrated-phased-array-based visible-light holographic projector is proposed as a scalable solution towards the next generation of augmented-reality head-mounted displays. A passive pixel-based architecture is developed and projection of a wire-frame cube is experimentally demonstrated © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Toward All MOCVD Grown InAs/GaAs Quantum Dot Laser on CMOS-compatible (001) Silicon
abstract: Indium arsenide quantum dots (QDs) are demonstrated on gallium arsenide on silicon templates by metalorganic chemical vapor deposition. The template threading dislocation density is only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$9.5\times 10^{6}\ \text{cm}^{-2}$</tex> and the ODs are of high quality. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Flat Lenses for Ultra-lightweight Longwave-Infrared Broadband Imaging
abstract: We demonstrate the design and experiments for chromatic aberration rectified, high NA, polarization insensitive, diffractive flat lenses operating in the LWIR (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$12\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>) regime. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Metalens-Enabled Low-Power Solid-State 2D Beam Steering
abstract: We demonstrate a platform for low-power solid-state beam steering in 2D using a single wavelength. This platform, based on a metalens and a switchable emitter array, enables steering of 12.4°× 26.8° using less than 83 mW. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Capacitively Coupled Silicon-Organic Hybrid Modulator for 200 Gbit/S PAM-4 Signaling
abstract: We demonstrate capacitively coupled silicon-organic hybrid (SOH)modulator with a π-voltage-length product of 1.3 V mm and 3 dB EO bandwidth exceeding 65 GHz. The modulator is used for 200 Gbit/s (100 GBd)PAM-4 signaling. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Liquid-Crystal-Based Visible-Light Integrated Optical Phased Arrays
abstract: Liquid-crystal-based integrated optical phased arrays are proposed and experimentally demonstrated for the first time as a method for low-power and compact visible-light beam steering. Beam steering of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10.5^{\circ}$</tex> within <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 3.5$</tex> V at a 632.8 nm wavelength is shown. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Lateral Integration of VCSEL and Amplifier with Resonant Wavelength Detuning Design
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the lateral integration of VCSEL and slow-light waveguide amplifier with in-plane resonant wavelength detuning design, enabling the unidirectional coupling. A record quasi-single-mode power (>27mW) with narrow beam divergence (<0.06°) is presented. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Low-Loss Ring-Core Fiber Supporting 4 Mode Groups
abstract: A ring-core fiber with a novel modulated-refractive-index profile is reported, whose low attenuation (~0.2 dB/km) and low inter-mode-group coupling coefficient (<-36 dB/km for adjacent high-order mode groups), both setting records for a ring-core fiber. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Embedded Dielectric Metasurface Based Subtractive Color Filter on a 300mm Glass Wafer
abstract: Si metasurface embedded subtractive color filters (SCFs)is firstly demonstrated on a 300mm glass wafer using CMOS-compatible fabrication process. Three transmission dips were observed at 528.568. and 598 nm wavelengths for different SCF designs. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Rapid Wideband RF Subsampling and Disambiguation Using Dual Combs
abstract: Using two electro-optic combs with an offset in the repetition rate, we disambiguate RF signals over 20 Nyquist bands. The setup doesn't require a pulse compression stage and can be readily integrated using existing technology. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Scalable Space-And-Wavelength Selective Switch Architecture Using Microring Resonators
abstract: A new architecture for space-and-wavelength selective switch fabrics is proposed. This class of designs built with a combination of microring-based channel-selectors and comb-aggregators completely blocks first-order in-band crosstalk enabling highly-scalable and flexible interconnection networks. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: FlexLION: A Reconfigurable All-to-All Optical Interconnect Fabric with Bandwidth Steering
abstract: We demonstrate an all-to-all interconnect fabric with bandwidth steering by wavelength routing, wavelength add/drop filtering and spatial switching. We report a proof-of-concept experiment and demonstrate scalability up to 32 ports with aggregated bandwidth of 51.2 Tb/s under worst-case crosstalk. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Bidirectional Fiber Transmission of mm W Signals Using Remote Downconversion and Wavelength Reuse
abstract: We demonstrate an RoF system with a simplified RRU, by employing a remote uplink downconversion and downlink wavelength reuse. An error-free transmission of 64-QAM UF-OFDM signals over 12 km of fiber is also shown. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Integrated DFB Lasers on Si3N4Photonic Platform for Chip-Scale Atomic Systems
abstract: 780 nm wavelength distributed feedback lasers have been integrated onto a Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> photonic platform on a Si substrate and coupled into waveguides for laser locking to either a ring resonator or rubidium vacuum cell. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Autaptic Circuits of Integrated Laser Neurons
abstract: The presence of autapses in neural networks enables complex temporal dynamics and information storage. We experimentally demonstrated feedback dynamics in an integrated laser neuron, which provides a proof-of-principle demonstration of cascadability and stable recurrent memory. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Single-Sideband Generation with Dual-Parallel Mach-Zehnder Modulators
abstract: We demonstrate the first silicon photonic single-sideband (SSB)modulator with dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulators (MZMs)operating near 1550 nm with a measured carrier suppression of 27 dB and at least 12 dB sideband suppression at 1 GHz. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Electronic-Photonic Platform for Label-Free Biophotonic Sensing in Advanced Zero-Change CMOS-SOI Process
abstract: We propose a monolithically integrated platform in a CMOS 45RFSOI process for biophotonic sensing. This platform opens the pathway to the first Lab-on-Chip system with nanophotonic sensing and advanced electronics on a single die.

articleTitle: 50 Gb/s PAM4 Low-Voltage Si-Ge Avalanche Photodiode
abstract: We demonstrate a 50 Gb/s PAM4 operation of an integrated Si-Ge APD with low breakdown voltage of −10 V. The receiver has achieved −17 dBm optical input power at 50 Gb/s PAM4 with a bit error rate of 2.4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup>• © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 1,000-Km Transmission of 1.5-Gb/S Y-00 Quantum Stream Cipher Using 4096-Level Intensity Modulation Signals
abstract: A real-time 1.5-Gb/s Y-00 quantum stream cipher transmission for secure optical communication is experimentally demonstrated. An error-free <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{BER} < 10^{-9})$</tex> transmission of 4096-level intensity-modulation cipher signals is achieved in a dispersion-managed link over 1,000 km. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A Switch-based Integrated 2D Beam-steering device for Lidar Application
abstract: A switch-based integrated two-dimensional beam-steering device is demonstrated on a silicon nitride platform at 1550nm. The device has O(logN) power consumption for N emitters, allows digital control and achieves 19 dB background suppression. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: The CLONETS – Clock Network Services Strategy and innovation for clock services over optical-fibre networks
abstract: Methods for long-distance time and frequency transfer over optical fibers have demonstrated excellent performances and are evolving rapidly. CLONETS is a European Union-funded coordination and support action intended to facilitate the vision of a sustainable, pan-European optical fiber network for precise time and frequency reference dissemination. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Parallel-Plate THz Waveguides for Relativistic Electron Bunch Compression
abstract: We present results from testing a new dispersion-free THz parallel-plate-based tapered structure optimized for focusing single-cycle THz pulses, producing high fields and with the potential for electron bunch compression to a few femtoseconds. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive amplitude-modulated CW LiDAR
abstract: We propose a 3D laser scanner having depolarization function which suppresses inherent fading by >20 dB at a maximum. To our knowledge, this is the first report of versatile fading removal for 3D laser scanners. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-Order Phase-Matching Enabled Octave-Bandwidth Four-Wave Mixing in AlGaAs-on-Insulator Waveguides
abstract: We show in simulation an ultra-broad continuous four-wave mixing conversion band over an octave span (covering <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.1-2.5\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> wavelength range) by taking advantage of the high-order phase-matching and the ultra-high effective nonlinearity of AlGaAs-on-insulator waveguides.

articleTitle: Photonic Integrated Si3N4 Ultra-Large-Area Grating Waveguide MOT Interface for 3D Atomic Clock Laser Cooling
abstract: We describe a silicon nitride (Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) photonic integrated circuit (PIC) designed to deliver non-diverging 780nm free-space optical cooling beams to an <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb atomic magneto optic trap (MOT) via fiber coupled ultra-large-area 3.88mm × 2.08mm gratings © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Nanostructured Photonic Power Splitter Design via Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: We train a convolutional neural network (CNN)that can predict the optical response of randomly generated nanopatterned photonic power splitters in a 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">400</sup> design space with a prediction correlation coefficient of 85 %. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-resolution Silicon Microring based Architecture for Optical Matrix Multiplication
abstract: We characterize silicon photonic microring resonators specifically designed with low Quality Factors (Q) to operate with high linearity measured over a range of 1.44 volts suitable for microring-based high resolution optical matrix multiplier architectures. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Additive Manufacturing of Fused Silica Glass Using Direct Laser Melting
abstract: A direct method for additive manufacturing of fused silica glass without any post treatment has been developed. By applying laser to process the fused silica paste, three-dimensional fused silica glass with high transparency wes obtained. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Performance of an Injection-Locked Active Demultiplexer for FSR-Tunable Optical Frequency Combs
abstract: An active injection-locked demultiplexer for optical combs with flexible channel spacing is demonstrated. Relationships between the injected power and frequency detuning of a 6.25GHz comb and the output comb suppression and phase noise are characterized. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: The Aging Study for Fine Pitch Quantum-Dot Array on LEDs
abstract: In this paper, we fabricated the photoresist mold whose pitch is smaller than 15 μm on light-emitting diode and printed two different cadmium-based quantum dots. Also, we burn-in the LED to compare their lifetime which are pasted barrier film by two different methods. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Exceeding 95% system efficiency within the telecom C-band in superconducting nanowire single photon detectors
abstract: We present a single-photon detector with system detection efficiencies exceeding 95% over the wavelength range 1520–1550 nm, with polarization sensitivities in the range of 1.02-1.08. The wavelength range is tunable over 200 nm via variation of the ton-two dielectric laver thicknesses. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Training Deep Neural Networks for the Inverse Design of Nanophotonic Structures
abstract: We demonstrate a tandem neural network architecture that tolerates inconsistent training instances in inverse design of nanophotonic devices. It provides a way to train large neural networks for the inverse design of complex photonic structures. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Broadband High-Resolution Scanning of Soliton Micro-Combs
abstract: We demonstrate continuous scanning of a single soliton micro-comb over 88 GHz with an instantaneous linewidth of 60 kHz. We show such a system can acquire spectra of HCN with a high spectral-resolution. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-Efficiency Silicon Mach-Zehnder Modulator with U-Shaped PN Junctions
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon Mach-Zehnder modulator with U-shaped PN junctions to achieve a high modulation efficiency of 0.34 V·cm at 0 V bias. On-off key modulation is obtained at 32 Gb/s data rate. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Silicon photonics optical frequency synthesizer - SPOFS
abstract: We demonstrate a silicon photonics optical frequency synthesizer (SPOFS). The frequency instability obtained in the telecom band is 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup> at 1s level, comparable to a bench-top commercial optical frequency synthesizer system.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonics External Cavity Laser with Misalignment Tolerant Multi-mode RSOA to PIC Interface
abstract: We present an external cavity laser with a silicon photonics PIC coupled to an RSOA with a multimode grating coupler. Also acting as a 3-dB splitter inside a Sagnac loop, it relaxes alignment tolerances.

articleTitle: Multi-FSR On-Chip Optical Interconnects Using Silicon Nitride AWGR
abstract: We demonstrate multi-FSR 10 Gb/s on-chip optical interconnects using an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\times 8$</tex> Si-LIONS monolithically integrated with a SiN cyclic AWGR and silicon photonic transceiver arrays. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Small-Form-Factor Optical Phased Array Module for Technology Adoption in Custom Applications
abstract: We present a small-form-factor optical phased array module with a 512-element array, driving CMOS ASICs, and interfacing FPGA. This 80×40×20mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> module enables unprecedented evaluation and adoption of optical phased array technology for custom applications. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Low Power Analog Coherent Links for Next-Generation Datacenters
abstract: Ever-increasing bandwidth demand in datacenter networks makes a move to coherent links seem inevitable. An “analog coherent” approach using optical phase locked loops can enable low-power consumption, expanded link budgets, low-latency, and future bandwidth scalability. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: An Outdoor Evaluation of 1-Gbps Optical Wireless Communication using AlGaN-based LED in 280-nm Band
abstract: The performance of solar-blind optical wireless communication using AIGaN-based LED at 280 nm-band was evaluated experimentally over a 1.5-m outdoor Line-of-Sight channel. Even under the summer sun, 1.18-Gbps error-free transmission was achieved. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: SOA-Based Metro-Access Coherent Transmission Systems
abstract: SOAs are demonstrated as in-line amplifiers in a metro-access system with potential for dynamic reconfiguration and traffic convergence with 5 spans of 40km of SMF and up to 7×200Gb/s DP-16QAM channels using 9 concatenated SOAs. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A Basic Approach for Speed Profiling of Alternating Targets with Photonic Doppler Velocimetry
abstract: Single tone continuous wave lidar system is utilized to construct the speed profile of an oscillating membrane by applying photonic Doppler velocimetry with amplitude-modulated light. Then short-time Fourier Transform is applied to acquire the profile. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Phase Noise Compensation for Ultra-Highly Sensitive Fiber-Optic Quasi-Distributed Acoustic Sensing System
abstract: An ultra-highly sensitive quasi-distributed acoustic sensing system is proposed with a phase-noise-compensated configuration, which gives a 11.55 dB improvement to the sensitivity. A sensitivity of 92.84 jε /✓ Hz @ 500–2500 Hz is achieved along a 20-km weak reflector array with 20-m spacing. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: SOA-Based Photonic Integrated Deep Neural Networks for Image Classification
abstract: We successfully demonstrate classification of three classes of Iris flowers by implementing a trained neural network on an SOA-based InP cross-connect chip. Classification accuracy of 91.6% is achieved after a fine optimization procedure.

articleTitle: Generating high performance, topologically-complex metasurfaces with neural networks
abstract: We show that generative neural networks, combined with topology optimization, are a computationally efficient route to producing high efficiency, topologically-complex metasurfaces across a broad operating parameter space. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Gb/s Physical Random Bits Through Mesoscopic Chaos in Integrated Silicon Optomechanical Cavities
abstract: We present a silicon-based physical random bits (PRBs) generator, where mesoscopic chaos comes from coupled material nonlinearities and optomechanical oscillation have been used to generate fast (1.25Gbit/s) PRBs, which successfully passed NIST-SP800-22 standard randomness tests. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Record-Sensitivity Gb/S Receiver for Free-Space Applications Based on Phase-Sensitive Amplification
abstract: We report error-free, 1 photon-per-bit receiver sensitivity using 10.52 Gb/s QPSK data and a half-rate FEC, enabled by a low-noise phase-sensitive pre-amplifier as well as injection-locking-based pump recovery at sub nano-watt powers. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Tapered atomic cladded nano waveguide for fine control of light-atom interaction
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the chip-scale integration of tapered nano waveguides and rubidium atoms. The optical mode interaction volume with the atoms is controlled by the tapering, giving rise to sub-Doppler atomic features and controlled interactions. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Shining the Light to Terahertz Spectroscopy of nL-Volume Biological Samples
abstract: We present a technique allowing the confinement of a broadband terahertz pulse to a few-nL volume. The method is approved in terahertz time-domain spectroscopy study of biological samples and further perspectives are discussed. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ring Resonator Based Ultrasound Detection in a Zero-Change Advanced CMOS-SOI Process
abstract: Optical ultrasound detection using microring resonators (MRRs) in a zero-change 45nm CMOS-SOI electronic-photonic platform with high intrinsic sensitivity of 39.6 fm/kPa and frequency response of 6MHz is reported.

articleTitle: Jitter-Free Multi-Wavelength Fiber Sources Using Intermodal Solitons
abstract: We demonstrate energetic (30nJ) dual-wavelength ultrashort-pulse sources via soliton self-mode conversion in a multimode fiber that are naturally temporally synchronized. Power fluctuations of resultant sum-frequency signals are 11.4dB lower than conventional fiber based dual-wavelength approaches. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Spatially Locked Mode in Defected Microring Resonators
abstract: Control of mode-splitting in a microring resonator is achieved by introducing notched scatters on its perimeter. Single step etching on SOI substrate enables the microring resonator to operate at exceptional point. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Free Electron Qubits
abstract: We show that a single relativistic free electron can carry one or multiple qubits within its wave-function in Floquet-dressed basis and implement 1-qubit gates based on the electron interaction with designed optical pulses. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Calibration-Free Wavelength Measurement with Sub-Femtometer Resolution Based on All-Fiber Rayleigh Speckles
abstract: We propose an ultra-high resolution wavelength measurement approach with all-fiber based system. By extracting the Rayleigh speckles of a single mode fiber, we achieve a spectral resolution of 0.3 fm in optical frequency measurement. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Single Particle Detection Enhancement with Wavelet-based Signal Processing Technique
abstract: Chip-based single molecule detection requires ultra-sensitive devices and robust signal processing methods. A new wavelet-based signal processing method is introduced that improves detection and error rates on an optofluidic platform by 2x and 3x, respectively. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Dimensional Quantum Key Distribution with Biphoton Frequency Combs through Energy-Time Entanglement
abstract: Biphoton frequency combs offer a photon-efficient way to achieve a very high-rate quantum key distribution by utilizing both time and frequency-bin encoding, while offering theoretically proven unconditional security. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Direct Frequency Locking of a Diode Laser to a Meter-Long High-Finesse Fiber Fabry-Perot Cavity
abstract: We report the demonstration of directly locking the frequency of a diode laser to a meter-long, high-finesse (~1000) fiber Fabry-Perot cavity. This work can serve as a key step toward ultra-sensitive infrasonic strain sensors. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Experimental study of non-orthogonal modes in tight-binding lattices
abstract: The non-orthogonality of modes is often neglected yet indispensable for an exact description of the dynamics in tight-binding lattices. We devise a compact arrangement to quantify these additional coupling parameters and observe their influence. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Hybrid Integration of Multi-Band, Tunable External-Cavity Diode Lasers for Wide-Angle Beam Steering
abstract: We demonstrate hybrid integration of multi-band tunable external cavity diode lasers with a silicon nitride photonic chip. We realize wide-angle beam steering by using the extremely wide wavelength tuning range provided by multi-band diode lasers. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 8-Ary Stokes-Vector Signal Generation and Transmission Employing a Simplified Transmitter
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a simple straight-line configuration of Stokes vector modulator with two cascaded phase modulators. Three-dimensional 8-ary Stokes-vector-modulated signal is generated at 30 Gb/s and transmitted over a 50-km dispersion-compensated single-mode fiber. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A Continuous-Variable Quantum Repeater based on Quantum Scissors
abstract: Using the quantum scissors operation for entanglement distillation and a single-rail Bell state projection for non-Gaussian entanglement swapping, we show a multiplexed quantum repeater scheme for continuous-variable entanglement distribution over a pure loss communication channel. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Modulation Bandwidth Enhancement and Chirp Reduction in DFB Lasers with Active Optical Feedback
abstract: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.55\ \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> DFB lasers with active optical feedback exhibits high modulation bandwidth and reduced frequency chirp. 25-Gb/s clearly open eyes and 10-km SMF error-free transmission with small power penalty was achieved.

articleTitle: DPSK-based 65536-ary Ciphering for Secure Optical Communications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a secure DPSK-based multi-dimensional 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup>-ary block ciphering system using a multiport encoder/decoder for secure optical fiber transmission. The proposed scheme presents a very high physical-level confidentiality. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Reduced Graphene Oxide Coated Photonic Crystal Fiber for All-Fiber Laser Mode Locking
abstract: The walls of two holes in a photonic crystal fiber were selectively coated with graphene oxide (GO)using a simple procedure. Thermally reducing GO then yielded 356-fs pulses in an all-fiber passively mode-locked ring laser. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optical-Feedback-Stabilized Quantum Cascade Laser Frequency Combs
abstract: Stabilization of quantum-cascade-laser frequency combs by means of external optical feedback is presented. Experimental results suggest reduced phase-noise in the frequency comb, allowing comb operation in previously unstable regimes. © 2019 The Authors

articleTitle: Differential Phase Noise Properties in QD-MLL and Its Performance in Coherent Transmission Systems
abstract: We show that the differential phase noise between adjacent comb lines in quantum-dot mode-locked lasers may exhibit higher phase noise impacts in coherent transmission systems than their apparent narrow linewidths, due to unique spectral profiles. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Real-time Observation of Soliton Build-up Dynamics in Bidirectional Mode-locked Fibre Lasers
abstract: By using newly emerged high precision real-time measurement technologies of spatiotemporal intensity reconstruction and dispersive Fourier transformation (DFT), we have experimentally observed the buildup dynamics of solitons in a bidirectional ultrafast fiber laser © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Mode-Multiplexed Transmission with Crosstalk Mitigation Using Amplified Spontaneous Emission (ASE)
abstract: We employ the short coherence length property of spectrally filtered amplified spontaneous emission (ASE) noise to mitigate modal crosstalk and demonstrate mode- and wavelength-multiplexed transmission over multimode fiber using a single ASE source. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of all-photonic quantum repeater
abstract: We for the first time demonstrate the all-photonic quantum repeater by manipulating a 12-photon interferometry. Our experiment opens a new window of opportunity for a memoryless quantum repeater with efficient photonic graph states. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Luneburg Lens for Wide-Angle Chip-Scale Optical Beam Steering
abstract: We present a design for a planar generalized Luneburg lens for use in a chip-scale optical beam steering device. The device has a theoretical in-plane field of view of 160° with no off-axis aberrations. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 94.8 Km-Range Direct Detection Fiber Optic Distributed Acoustic Sensor
