abstract: We present a Vernier optical phased array transceiver architecture that suppresses grating lobes and can extend the field-of-view. The first experimental demonstration shows Vernier lobe suppression by transmitting from adjacent TX and RX tiles simultaneously. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Demonstration of Four-Party 32-Dimensional Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger Entangled State
abstract: By utilizing two-qudit SUM gates between time and frequency degrees of freedom in photons, we demonstrate a high-dimensional non-separable state between two degrees of freedom of photonic states, and realize a four-party 32-dimensional GHZ state. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Entangled photon transmission from a quantum dot over loop-back fiber in Cambridge network
abstract: Quantum dots are considered to be one of the most important quantum emitters due to their ability of emitting entangled single photons, which have not yet been practically used for large-scale quantum communication. In this work [1], we have realized the transmission of polarization-encoded entangled single photons at the telecommunication O-band emitted from a quantum dot over a loop-back fiber in the Cambridge fiber network. To maintain the polarization, an active feedback system with two classical reference beams is implemented. Stable transmission of high-fidelity (91.3%) entanglement has been achieved over one week, which is a significant step toward the application of quantum dots in quantum networks. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Phonon-Induced Multi-Color Correlations in HBN Single-Photon Emitters
abstract: We explore electron-phonon dynamics in hBN defects and observe $\text{g}^{(2)}(0)=0.20$ in a phonon replica and $\text{g}^{(2)}(0)=0.18$ between a phonon replica and the zero-phonon line, and we examine Purcell enhancement of phonon replicas with phononic cavities.

articleTitle: Efficient ablation of silicon with high power GHz femtosecond laser source
abstract: Ablation of silicon using high power GHz femtosecond lasers achieves specific removal rate of 2.5 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/min/W. Ablation morphologies are discussed in terms of thermal and non-thermal mechanisms © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Nonlinear Dielectric Metalenses: Imaging and Higher-Order Correlations
abstract: We demonstrate the first highly efficient all-dielectric nonlinear metalens that realizes third-harmonic imaging accompanied by spatial third-order correlations carrying information about coherence effects. We describe this metalens analytically with a generalized nonlinear lens equation. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Detection of 10 dB vacuum noise squeezing at 1064 nm by balanced homodyne detectors with a common mode rejection ratio more than 80 dB
abstract: We report our implementation of a squeezer, by generating squeezed vacuum state at 1064 nm through a bow-tie optical parametric oscillator cavity operated below the threshold. With the help of our home-made balanced homodyne detector (BHD), characterized with a Common Mode Rejection Ratio (CMRR) more than 80 dB, a noise reduction up to 10 dB is observed.

articleTitle: Abruptly focusing X-waves: Nondiffracting waves with localized disruptions
abstract: We present a family of electromagnetic wavepackets with nondiffracting behavior for most of their propagation, but are capable of extremely strong focusing behavior at specified locations, enhancing their peak intensity by over 200 times. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Poling Optical Fibers with UV Lamp
abstract: Silicate fibers with internal electrodes are optically poled without a laser by side-exposure to radiation from a UV tubular lamp. Electrooptic coefficients ϰ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>~ 0.04 pm/V and Vπ = 810 V are obtained. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: The Curious Properties of Twisted Photonic Crystal Fibers
abstract: Helically twisted hollow and solid core photonic crystal fibers display many curious properties: perfect circular birefringence, circular dichroism, birefringence between modes of equal and opposite azimuthal order, and guidance even when there is no core. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: An absorbance spectrum estimation-based accurate colorization method for holographic imaging of pathology slides
abstract: We present an accurate-color holographic imaging method for pathology slide samples based on absorbance spectrum estimation of histochemical stains, which improves the color accuracy and reduces the required number of illumination wavelengths.

articleTitle: Photon Pair Generation and Filtering Using Monolithically Integrated Silicon Micro-Disk and Coupled Resonator Optical Waveguide
abstract: We demonstrate on-chip pair of photons with spectral brightness of 4.84 ⨯ 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> pair/s/mW2/GHz in micro-disk resonator integrated with on-chip tunable filter to provide high isolation of the pump.© 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Excitonic Effects in Single Layer MoS2 Probed by Broadband Two-dimensional Electronic Spectroscopy
abstract: We exploit two-dimensional electron spectroscopy to coherently excite the A and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{B}$</tex> excitons in monolayer Mos<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Combined with simulations, our data distinguish ultrafast bright excitons decoherence and sub-ps scattering decays to dark excitons. OCIS codes 300.6530. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Dynamic Phase Modulation Induced Nonreciprocity of Optical Metasurfaces
abstract: By exploiting both spatial and temporal phase modulation, we experimentally demonstrate an ultrathin nonlinear metasurface with broken reciprocity at wavelengths around 860 nm. Our approach paves a way for miniaturized on-chip nonreciprocal optical components. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Trace-Gas Spectroscopy of Methane Using a Monolithically Integrated Silicon Photonic Chip Sensor
abstract: We present a monolithically integrated photonic sensor incorporating an on-chip 111- V laser, detector, sealed reference cell, and sensing waveguide capable of near-infrared absorption spectroscopy of methane near λ = 1651 nm. Sub-100 pprnv-Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1/2</sup> sensitivities are demonstrated. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Q-Factor All-Dielectric Metasurface Based on Bound States in the Continuum
abstract: We propose a realization of bound states in the continuum (BICs) with metasurfaces. Resonances with theoretically-infinite quality-factors can be achieved in the BIC regime and with up to a few thousand in the near-BIC. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Coherent Propulsion with Negative-mass Fields in a Photonic Setting
abstract: We demonstrate an optical self-accelerating state driven by nonlinear coherent interaction of its constituting components with opposite “mass-sign”. The coherent propulsion, highly immune to initial phase conditions, is surprisingly enhanced comparing to its incoherent counterpart. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Absorptivity and energy scaling associated with laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing
abstract: In situ absorptivity measurements and finite element modeling are used to characterize energy coupling mechanisms and scaling behavior in laser powder bed fusion additive manufacturing. A universal relationship is derived that predicts melt depth and absorptivity. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Single-Carbon-Nanotube Photonics and Optoelectronics
abstract: Single-walled carbon nanotubes exhibit telecom-band emission at room temperature and they can be directly synthesized on silicon substrates. Here we discuss the use of individual carbon nanotubes for generation and manipulation of photons on a chip, © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Terahertz Kerr Effect in ${\beta}$-Alumina Ion Conductors
abstract: We present THz Kerr effect spectra of Na, K, and Ag <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta$</tex>-alumina solid-state ion conductors as model systems for grid-scale battery applications. We show both a field-following response consistent with electronic polarization, and a slower relaxation consistent with translation of mobile ions. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Photonic bands in 230 space groups
abstract: We present the symmetry constraints on photonic bands for all 230 space groups with time-reversal symmetry. The results of minimum band connectivities provide useful design insights for photonic crystals, metamaterials, and topological lattices. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optical Spatial Differentiator Based on Subwavelength High-Contrast Gratings
abstract: Based on subwavelength high-contrast gratings (HCGs), a transmissive optical spatial differentiator without Fourier lens is proposed experimentally, which achieves edge detections of images and provides applications in optical computing systems and parallel data processing. (tel: +86 138 1627 3160, e-mail: xxdeng@sjtu.edu.cn).©2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Machine Learning Applied in Reconstruction of Unitary Matrix for Quantum Computation
abstract: Optimal method are applied in characterizing and reconstructing designed unitary matrices on linear optical circuit. The scheme is based on the measurement of single-photon and two-photon statistics using coherent beams. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Towards a source of entangled photon pairs in gallium phosphide
abstract: We investigate parametric down-conversion in orientation-patterned GaP. Pumped at 865 nm, the signal and idler are at 1350 nm and 2400 nm, respectively. ©2019TheAuthor(s)

articleTitle: Optoelectronic biosensing in graphene driven fiber resonators with single-molecule sensitivity and selectivity
abstract: By implementing partially-reduced graphene oxide in fiber-calibrated Fabry-Perot resonators, we demonstrate a biosensing platform. By measuring the functionalized FRET and the intermode heterodyne interference, we achieve single-molecule sensitivity and selectivity for multiple target detection. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Integration of Light-Emitting Transistors on Silicon for Hybrid Electronic-Photonic Logic Circuitry
abstract: An array of heterogeneously integrated light-emitting transistors is fabricated after an epitaxial transfer process bonds and interconnects active III-V photonic material onto a CMOS-compatible host wafer for the purposes of establishing a photonic logic network.

articleTitle: Tracking the Phase Transition in VO2 using High Harmonic Spectroscopy
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of the insulator-to-metal phase transition in VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> with high temporal resolution using a new method of time-resolved high harmonic spectroscopy in a solid-state system, revealing all electronic states involved. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Nearly Color-shift Free Full-color Monolithic Hybrid Quantum Dots Semipolar Micro Light-emitting Diodes Display
abstract: Full-color displays demonstrate by the semipolar blue micro-light-emitting diodes array and quantum dots color-conversion layer. This display shows a wide color gamut and color stability since reduced quantum confined Stark effect by the semipolar substrate.

articleTitle: Robust Exceptional Points
abstract: We construct a theory to introduce the concept of robust exceptional points against disorder in photonics. Our proposal will advance the concept of topological localized states to an unexplored area of topological extended (bulk) states. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Femtosecond-Laser-Induced Blisters in Polymer Thin Films and Application as Microlenses
abstract: We present the phenomenology of blister formation by nonlinear absorption of femtosecond pulses in polyimide films, characterized by atomic force microscopy. We demonstrate a novel implementation of blisters as microlenses. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultra-Low Loss Integrated Lithium Niobate Photonics in Visible Wavelengths
abstract: We demonstrate a low loss integrated photonic platform in lithium niobate in the visible wavelength range. We show microring resonators with a quality factor of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> and gigahertz intensity modulators. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optimization of Cbalcogenide Negative Curvature Fibers for CO2 Laser Transmission
abstract: We study the geometry of chalcogenide negative curvature fibers with different numbers of tubes and different core diameters. We optimize the design of chalcogenide negative curvature fibers for CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser transmission.

articleTitle: Application of deep learning to direct and inverse problems in plasmonic coloring
abstract: Laser pulses can color noble metals by inducing nanoparticles on their surface. We apply deep learning to solve the direct and inverse problems which link nanoparticle distributions and laser parameters to the produced colour. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Multifocal Compressive Sensing Spectral Domain Optical Coherence Tomography Based on Bessel Beam
abstract: We present a method CS-MB-SDOCT, which combines multifocal Bessel beam spectral-domain optical coherence tomography (MB-SDOCT) and compressive sensing (CS) to increase the imaging depth using a spectrometer with lower spectral resolution.

articleTitle: Measuring the Optical Temperature of a Soliton
abstract: Under thermal equilibrium conditions, we show that the zeroth law of thermodynamics can be used to measure a soliton's optical temperature in a nonlinear multimode system. Here, the modal gas plays the role of an optical thermometer. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Inverse Designed Diamond Nanophotonics
abstract: Combining inverse design optimization methods and quasi-isotropic etching techniques, we develop compact, flexible and efficient photonic components in diamond for applications in quantum technologies. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Realization of optical isolator at room temperature in miniaturized vapor cell using light induced atomic desorption
abstract: A compact, on-chip atomic optical isolator using light induced atomic desorption technique is demonstrated. A millimeter size fabricated vapor cell integrated with small permanent magnets of ≈ 300 Gauss are used to realize an atomic optical isolator at room temperature.

articleTitle: 0.25 mW Pulsed Terahertz Radiation from Bias-Free, Telecommunication-Compatible Plasmonic Nanoantennas
abstract: We present a bias-free, telecommunication-compatible photoconductive terahertz source, which offers radiation powers exceeding 0.25 mW, enabling time-domain terahertz spectroscopy with more than a 90 dB dynamic range over a 0.1-3.5 THz bandwidth. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Dual-Comb Spectroscopy with Si3N4waveguides for Gas Spectroscopy in the 2 μm–2.5 μm Water Window
abstract: Dual-comb spectroscopy of CO and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is reported in the important 2-2.5 μm atmospheric transparency window, using broadening in tailored ShN4 waveguides and extending beyond Si-based fibers' transparency window. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Observation of corner states in topological photonic crystal slabs
abstract: With the near-field scanning measurement, we show the observation of in-gap corner states in topological photonic crystal slabs which consist of periodic dielectric rods on a perfect electric conductor. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optical Needle with Ultra-Small Resolution Enabled by Integrated Metalens
abstract: We present a metalens composed of integrated metasurfaces to achieve an optical needle with ultra-small optical resolution of λ/5. This metalens is promising for non-intrusive, far-field super-resolution optical imaging. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Pulse shortening in two coupled rings under amplitude modulations with parity-time symmetry
abstract: We show pulse shortening in two coupled rings under amplitude modulations, where the modulation phases have a π phase difference. The system exhibits parity-time symmetry, and its importance is highlighted in pulsed laser systems. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Surface Modification Effects of Femtosecond and Nanosecond Laser on CVD Diamond Tools During Sharpening Processing
abstract: In this study sharpening processing with femtosecond laser was innovatively performed on CVD diamond tools. Furthermore, surface modification effects of femtosecond and nanosecond laser in sharpening processing on CVD diamond were compared with Raman spectroscopy. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Flexible Polaritons: Wannier Exciton-Plasmon Coupling in Metal-Semiconductor Structures
abstract: When Rabi energy exceeds the exciton binding energy a Wannier Exciton-Plasmon Polariton (WEPP) bound to the metal nanoparticle is formed. It is characterized by small excitonic radius and higher ionization energy that can exceed 100me V. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Low Energy Hollow Core Fiber Pulse Compression Using Molecular Gases
abstract: We show that hydrofluorocarbons can be used for efficient hollow core fiber pulse broadening. Fivefold compression, 45 fs down to ~9 fs, of low-energy titanium-sapphire laser pulses <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\sim 16\mu \mathrm{J})$</tex> is achieved. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Broad Visible Frequency Comb with 24-GHz Mode-Spacing Based on Mode-Locked Erbium-Fiber Laser
abstract: We developed a 24-GHz spacing comb based on a mode-locked Er-fiber laser and mode-filtering technique. The broad comb spectrum in infrared region was converted to visible region by a PPLN waveguide. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Programmable VCSEL-Based Transceivers for Multi-Terabit Capacity Networking
abstract: Photonic transceivers adopting large-bandwidth vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs)at long-wavelength, coherent detection and adaptive digital signal processing are presented as promising programmable architectures to provide multi-terabit capacity in future software-defined optical metro networks. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Efficient Conversion to Very High Order Modes in Silicon Waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate robust mode conversion up to the 12<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> higher order mode in silicon waveguides by using an optimized adiabatic directional coupler and using subwavelength waveguides. The conversion efficiency is better than −1.5 dB over a 75 nm bandwidth and tolerating ±30 nm fabrication variations. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Development of Terahertz Quantum-Cascade Lasers for Satellite-Borne Measurement of Key Gas Species
abstract: We present key developments towards atmospheric chemistry studies using terahertz quantum-cascade lasers (QCLs), including ~1-cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>-scale integration of THz QCLs with waveguides and antennas using precision micromachining, and broadband multimode spectroscopy based on detector-free self-mixing. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Femtosecond Micromachining of Ophthalmic Hydrogels: effects of laser repetition rate on the induced phase change in the two photon and four photon absorption limit
abstract: We study and model effects of laser wavelength, repetition rate and other parameters on writing refractive index changes with a femtosecond laser in ophthalmic hydrogels. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Continuous Wave Green Lasing at Room Temperature in Two-Dimensional Photonic Crystal Perovskite Laser
abstract: Direct patterning of methylammonium lead bromide (MAPbBr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>)perovskite enabled green lasing in two-dimensional photonic crystal on the Si platform, under continuous wave pumping at room temperature for the first time. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Energy-Time Entanglement Based Dispersive Optics Quantum Key Distribution over Optical Fibers of 20 km
abstract: An energy-time entanglement based dispersive-optics quantum key distribution is demonstrated experimentally over 20 km optical fibers, in which photon pairs are generated by spontaneous four wave mixing in a silicon waveguide. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: All-fiber dual-wavelength mode-locked laser by using low-birefringence lyot-filter and carbon nanotube
abstract: We firstly demonstrate a dual-wavelength mode-locked EDF laser by utilizing a low-birefringence Lyot-filter and CNT, which delivers dual-wavelength output centers at 1532 nm and 1556 nm corresponds to the difference frequency of 3.02 THz. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Harmonic Generation in Reflection and Transmission from Gallium Arsenide
abstract: High harmonic generation in reflection and transmission from gallium arsenide is investigated using femtosecond infrared pulses. Harmonic spectra obtained in both geometries show drastic difference with each other, indicating significant contribution of nonlinear propagation. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Sub-V Opto-Electro-Mechanical Switch
abstract: We demonstrate plasmonic-electro-mechanical-switches that feature a plasmonic resonator (Q> 1000). This enables low on/off voltages (875mV)and low insertion losses <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\sim1\text{dB})$</tex> The performance proofs that plasmonics is competitive with photonics not only at highest speed. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Two-dimensional Large-angle Scanning Optical Phased Array with Single Wavelength Beam
abstract: A two-dimensional scanning optical phased array can easily achieve a circular scanning range of 51.84 °, 81.6% emission efficiency and 29.7dB back suppression ratio at 1550nm by adopting a high contrast grating (HCG) optical antenna.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic Supercontinuum based Mid-Infrared Dual-Comb Spectroscopy
abstract: We demonstrate a broadband mid-infrared dual-comb spectroscopy for parallel gas-phase detection in the functional group region from 2800–3600 cm <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, using dispersion engineered silicon nitride dual-core waveguides which produce broadband, intensity-enhanced and coherent mid-infrared frequency combs. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Wide Bandwidth, Nonmagnetic Linear Optical Isolators based on Frequency Conversion
abstract: We propose a family of nonmagnetic optical isolators based on waveguide frequency conversion and characterized by good isolation properties, high linearity, bandwidth as high as a few THz. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Fabrication of Near-Field Optical Fiber Probes Through Focused Ion Beam
abstract: We describe a procedure to fabricate a near-field optical fiber probe using focused ion beam milling. The method allows to control the fiber taper angle for better throughput, and the taper length for mechanical robustness. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Third-and Fourth-Harmonic Generation in Cascaded Periodically-Poled Lithium Niobate Ultracompact Waveguides on Silicon
abstract: Cascaded harmonic generation is demonstrated in submicron thin-film periodically poled lithium niobate nonlinear waveguides on a silicon substrate. Harmonics to the third and fourth order are produced through second-harmonic and sum-frequency generation. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Genuine Counterfactual Communication with a Nanophotonic Processor
abstract: In counterfactual communication particles and information can travel in opposite directions. With our high-fidelity programmable nanophotonic processor we implement the first trace-free counterfactual protocol without post-selection with a counterfactual violation as low as 2.4%. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Efficient Pure Phase Optical Modulator Based on Strongly Over-Coupled Resonators
abstract: We demonstrate that large pure optical phase modulation is possible in resonators operated in the strongly over-coupling regime, which suggests efficient phase modulators with high-speed operation, small footprint, low insertion loss, and low power consumption. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Reducing Actuation Nonlinearity of MEMS Phase Shifters for Reconfigurable Photonic Circuits
abstract: The low power consumption of MEMS actuators enables large-scale reconfigurable photonic circuits. However, insertion loss and actuation linearity need improvement. By simulations and experiments, we analyze the dominating design parameters affecting linearity and suggest improvements. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Development of Path-Integrated Remote Chirped Laser Dispersion Spectrometer with Automatic Target Tracking
abstract: The recent developments in instrumentation for mobile field deployment of a chirped laser dispersion spectroscopy is discussed, including optomechanical considerations, system signal fidelity, and real-time target tracking for chemical plume detection.

articleTitle: The NAOMI GAZL multispecies differential absorption lidar: realization and testing on the TADI gas leak simulation facility
abstract: We report on a differential absorption lidar, designed for remote detection of CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, based on a single-frequency 1.57-1.65 μm parametric oscillator/amplifier system. The lidar is tested on a controlled gas release facility. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Multi-phase-matched satellite frequency combs
abstract: We report Kerr frequency combs with satellite clusters spanning beyond conventional phase-matching bandwidth. The evolution of the signal and idler satellites at ≈ 1.3 ≈ and 1.9 μm regimes are detailed. With proper pump parameters, the satellites can span up to one full octave. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Near Ultraviolet Light Emission in Hexagonal Boron Nitride Based van der Waals Heterostructures
abstract: We demonstrate light emitting devices consisting of graphene layers separated and by thin hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) with additional hBN encapsulation. At high bias through two graphene layer, thin hBN produce near ultraviolet (NUV) light emission at 394 nm. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Observation of Branched Flow of light
abstract: We present the first study of optical branched flow. As light propagates in thin dielectric films it experiences scattering from inhomogeneities, forming bundles displaying the features and statistics of the phenomenon known as branched flow. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Semi-analytic modeling of chiral metasurface stacks
abstract: We analyze the polarization response of a fabricated twisted nano-wire meta-surface stack using a semi-analytic algorithm. This lifts the requirement for rigorous simulations when designing metasurface stacks with specific target functionalities. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Spectroscopy With Frequency Comb-Locked Optical Swept Synthesizer
abstract: A CW-laser phase-locked to an endlessly shifting frequency comb enables spectroscopic investigations with metrological quality and high sensitivity at speeds beyond 1 THz/s over frequency ranges that can be set on demand over 10 THz.

articleTitle: High-Sensitivity Coherent Raman Spectroscopy with Doppler Raman
abstract: Doppler Raman spectroscopy is a novel detection scheme for impulsively stimulated Raman scattering that unlocks high-sensitivity detection of low frequency Raman vibrational modes from 10cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> to 1500cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> through signal amplification in the external detection system.© 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Embedded-Core Optical Fiber for Distributed Pressure Measurement Using an Autocorrelation OFDR Technique
abstract: We present a pressure sensor using an optical frequency domain reflectometer and a simplified microstructured fiber. High sensitivity, ease of fabrication and distributed sensing makes the proposed configuration a promising technique for pressure sensing applications. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Nested-Capillary Anti-Resonant Silica Fiber with Mid-Infrared Transmission and Very Low Bending Sensitivity at 4000 Nm
abstract: Silica glass nested capillary anti -resonant fiber is reported. Transmission is measured with 150cm long sample over 1700-4200nm wavelengths, revealing a 3500-4200nm window. The fiber is bending insensitive down to 0.5cm radius over a full loop. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Polarization Effects in Silicon-Nitride Waveguides: Super-Continuum, Carrier-Envelope Offset, and Optical Beatnotes
abstract: Polarization dependence of second/third-harmonic and supercontinuum generation in silicon-nitride waveguides is mapped from 350–1750 nm. We identify parameters suited for generating coherent signals near 500 and 1000 nm for optical clocks, f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CEO</inf> and beatnote detection. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Single-Shot Subnoise Signal Recovery by Coherent Spectral Energy Redistribution
abstract: We demonstrate single-shot recovery of subnoise signals, completely buried under random in-band noise, through combinations of phase manipulations derived from Talbot effect theory, allowing for reconstruction of signals with a time-bandwidth-product of up to 24.

articleTitle: RI Sensitivity of Tapered MCF Enhanced by Graphene Coating
abstract: RI-sensitivity of a tapered MCF interferometer is investigated and enhanced by graphene coating. The microstructure with a graphene coating has achieved a RI-sensitivity of 12617.3 nm/RIU within the RI range of 1.4144 to 1.4159. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Brightness Operation in Broad Area Quantum Cascade Lasers with Reduced Number of Stages
abstract: Two 20 µm wide QCL structures demonstrate room temperature watt-level CW power with single lobed behavior. A figure of merit predicts broad area, fundamental mode behavior configurations for QCLs of identical wavelength and stage height.© 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Multiple Modal and Wavelength Conversion Process of a 10-Gbit/s Signal in a 6-LP-Mode Fiber
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a simultaneous threefold modal and wavelength conversion process of a 10-Gbit/s NRZ signal in a 1.8-km long 6-LP-mode fiber. The principle of operation is based on a phase-matched inter-modal four-wave mixing phenomenon.

articleTitle: Laguerre-Gaussian Mode Laser Heater for Microbunching Instability Suppression in Free Electron Lasers
abstract: We report on the use of a Laguerre-Gaussian transverse mode in the LCLS laser heater resulting in better suppression of microbunching instability. We discuss the impact on FEL performance. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 4H-SiC-on-Insulator Platform for Quantum Photonics
abstract: We present a 4H-Silicon-Carbide-on-Insulator platform that enables versatile integration of color centers with photonic devices.

articleTitle: Combined Probabilistic Shaping and Nyquist Pulse Shaping for PAM8 Signal Transmission in WDM Systems
abstract: We use the LDPC-coded probabilistically shaped PAM8 signaling combined with Nyquist pulse shaping to improve the transmission performance in a WDM system. We find that the combination of these shaping schemes offers great performance improvement. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Optical and Electrical Properties of Phase Change Materials for High-Speed Optoelectronics
abstract: By doping Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> phase change material with tungsten, we produce material with improved electrical properties while simultaneously maintaining the optical contrast necessary for light modulation and switching. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Spectral Magnification System for All-Optical WDM Grid Manipulation in Dispersion Un-Compensated Transmission
abstract: We investigate spectral magnification as a tool for optical spectral grid manipulation in dispersion un-compensated communication systems. The presence of dispersion can be utilized to circumvent the need for temporal synchronization of pumps and signal. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: The 9.2 μm, 2 Ps, Multi-Terawatt Laser at the Accelerator Test Facility (ATF)of Brookhaven National Laboratory
abstract: A terawatt-class long-wave infrared (LWIR)laser based on chirped-pulse amplification of picosecond pulses in mixed-isotope, high pressure CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> amplifiers is in operation at ATF. An overview of the laser system as well as a summary of recent progress and status are presented. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 2D Perovskite-Based Metasurfaces for Enhanced Plasmonic Sensing
abstract: We demonstrated a surface plasmon resonance sensor based on 2D Perovskite and Goos-Hänchen shift exhibiting sensitivity up to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$900,000 \mu \mathrm{m}/\mathrm{RIU}$</tex> for refractive index sensing of target analytes. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Overcoming the diffraction limit of optical microscopes for measuring tapered optical fibers
abstract: We describe a technique that allows increasing the resolution of optical microscopes for nanofiber measurements. We demonstrated it by measuring the diameter of tapered fibers for radii ranging from 0.2 to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.5\ \mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>.

articleTitle: High-Responsivity and Broadband Photoconductive Terahertz Detection via Photon Trapping
abstract: We present a photoconductive terahertz detector, which utilizes photon trapping to offer broadband terahertz detection, over a 0.1-4.5 THz band, with large dynamic ranges, exceeding 100 dB, without using a short-carrier-lifetime semiconductor substrate. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Compact, Ultra-Tunable InGaSb/AlGaAsSb Si External Cavity Laser at the Mid-Infrared (MIR)
abstract: We present the first MIR hybrid Si external cavity laser with a tunable range below the 2 μm mark. To the best of our knowledge, we have achieved the largest tunable range of 66 nm (1881–1947 nm) near the 2 μm waveband in silicon photonics. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Graphene-coated Suspended Metallic Nanostructures for Fast and Sensitive Optomechanical Infrared Detection
abstract: We investigate the effect of incorporating graphene in suspended metallic nanostructures for radiation detection. We have found enhanced absorptance resulting in increased sensitivity and faster operation owing to graphene's extraordinary plasmonic and thermal properties. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A 2.35-{\mu} {m} Pumped Subharmonic OPO Reaches the Spectral Width of Two Octaves in the Mid-IR
abstract: We used an orientation-patterned gallium phosphide (OP-GaP) crystal combined with an ultrafast $2.35-\mu \text{m}$ pump (1.2W, 79 MHz, 62 fs) to demonstrate a subharmonic sync-pumped OPO with an instantaneous output spectrum of $3-12.5\ \mu \text{m}$.

articleTitle: Hydrostatic Pressure Response of Mo Coated Etched Fiber Bragg Grating Sensor in Side-Hole Packaging
abstract: We demonstrate side-hole packaged; nanolayer Molybdenum (Mo) coated etched Fiber Bragg Grating (eFBG) as hydrostatic pressure sensor. Pressure sensitivity enhancement of nearly 2000 times is observed with such a simple, ruggedized and packaged sensor system.

articleTitle: Picosecond Optical Switching in Silicon Photonics Using Phase-Changing Vanadium Dioxide
abstract: Experiments in hybrid vanadium dioxide-silicon photonic structures, complemented by finite-difference, time-domain simulations, show how the ultrafast insulator-to-metal transition in VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> can be leveraged in nanoscale photonic structures to open new routes to low-loss, high-speed all-optical modulators. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: CW-probe-less OOK and BPSK to QPSK optical modulation format conversion and SSMF transmission
abstract: A pair of OOK and BPSK to QPSK format conversion with XPM and its 50km SSMF transmission of the optically converted QPSK are experimentally demonstrated. A HNLF input power tolerance of OOK is also reported.

articleTitle: Low-loss geometrical phase elements by ultrafast laser writing in silica glass
abstract: Femtosecond laser induced birefringence with negligible transmission loss in silica glass is observed. Ultra-low loss birefringent optical elements including UV retarders and geometric phase optics are demonstrated. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Frequency-modulated continuous-wave lidar using a phase-diversity coherent optical receiver for simultaneous ranging and velocimetry
abstract: Conventional FMCW lidar has ambiguous ranging and velocimetry if de-chirped frequency related to distance is close to Doppler frequency shift related to velocity, which is avoided in this work using a phase-diversity coherent optical receiver. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Hollow-Core Conjoined-Tube Negative-Curvature Fiber with Loss Approaching Rayleigh Scattering Limit of Silica
abstract: We report on a hollow-core conjoined-tube negative-curvature fiber with measured transmission losses of2.7dB/km at 1150nm and 3.8dB/km at 680nm. The loss from 653 to 706 nm approaches the Rayleigh scattering limit of silica fiber. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Joule-Class 500 Hz Cryogenic Yb: YAG Chirped Pulse Amplifier
abstract: A cryogenic Yb:YAG composite-thin-disk laser driver has demonstrated stable operation at 500 Hz with l-joule 20-ns pulses. Results with chirped pulses will be presented. Joule-level pulses at 500 Hz compressible to 5 ps are expected. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Spectral phase coherence in HOM interferometry
abstract: We examine the role of spectral phase in Hong-Ou-Mandel interference by comparing interferograms for pure and mixed states. We find that HOM interference cannot be taken as a signature of coherent frequency superpositions.

articleTitle: Inverse Designed Fano Resonance in Silicon Microresonators
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that, for standard silicon-photonic resonators, a Fano lineshape can be created in the response function by placing an inverse-designed reflecting element into the side-coupled waveguide. Inverse design allows for robust control of the Fano spectrum and small device footprint, with wide applications in optical sensing, switching, and passive isolation. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Graphene Modified Plasmonic Guided Mode for CO2 Detection
abstract: We observed broadening of the plasmonic guided modes in gold nanorod arrays by a single layer graphene, which can manifest CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> detection. The plasmonic modes enhance absorption by over 35% from 729 to 621 em<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, © 2019 The Author(s)

Author Keywords: (040.2235) Far infrared or terahertz (280.4788) Optical sensing and sensors

articleTitle: Tri-Comb and Quad-Comb Generation from a Multi-Dimensional-Multiplexed Fiber Laser
abstract: By tapping into multiple wave-guiding dimensions in optical fiber, it is demonstrated that up to four wavelength/polarization multiplexed, asynchronous ultrashort pulse sequences can be generated with good stability from an all-fiber, ring-cavity, mode-locked fiber laser.

articleTitle: GHz Dual-Comb Spectroscopy with 110-{\mu}{s} Time Resolution
abstract: We demonstrate high-speed dual-comb spectroscopy by spectrally filtering frequency combs using two Fabry-Perot cavities. Using this system, we measured the spectrum of CO with high signal to noise in $110\ \mu\text{s}$ and 1 GHz resolution.

articleTitle: Compact Dot Projector based on Folded Path VCSEL Amplifier for Structured Light Sensing
abstract: We demonstrate a VCSEL amplifier with folded-path waveguide layout and cylindrical lens array for the dot projection. We obtained >5,000 dots in a viewing angle of 12° × 15° for 0.4 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> chip size. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-Order Mode Brillouin Fiber Lasers Based on Intra-and Inter-Modal SBS
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode Brillouin fiber lasers based on both intra-and inter-modal SBS. The OSNRs were over 65 dB, and their mode profiles were clearly observed for both cases.© 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Cost-effective, CMOS-compatible, label-free biosensors using doped silicon detectors and a broadband source
abstract: By replacing Ge-based photodetectors and tunable lasers with doped silicon photoconductive heater-detectors and broadband sources, we propose and demonstrate a cost-effective implementation of photonic sensors for biosensing applications. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultranarrow-band metagrating absorbers for sensing and modulation
abstract: An asymmetric metagrating structure with an ultranarrow bandwidth of 0.28 nm at 1.55 μm is proposed. Sensing with figure-of-merit of 1333.33 RIU<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and electro-optic modulation with dynamic range of 15.52 dB are numerically demonstrated. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Phase-Shifted Bragg Grating Resonators in Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Waveguides
abstract: We demonstrate narrowband integrated filters with 0.23 mm-long phase-shifted Bragg gratings in corrugated single-mode thin-film LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> photonic wires, achieving quality factors of 1.24×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> and extinction ratios up to 24 dB at telecom wavelengths. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Fiber Nonlinearity Compensation Using Erbium-Doped-Fiber-Assisted Dual-Order Raman Amplification
abstract: We propose a novel dual-order backward-pumped distributed Raman amplification scheme assisted by 25cm erbium-doped-fiber providing nearly perfect multi-span signal power symmetry and 7dB nonlinear threshold improvement for 256Gb/s inline transmission when deploying optical phase conjugation. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Beam-Steering Nanophotonic Phased-Array Neural Probes
abstract: We demonstrate the first implantable nanophotonic neural probes with integrated silicon nitride phased arrays. Coherent beam-steering is achieved in brain tissue by wavelength tuning. Beam profiles, optogenetic stimulation, and functional imaging are validated in vitro.

articleTitle: High-Dimensional Energy-Time Entanglement up to 6 Qubits per Photon through Biphoton Frequency Comb
abstract: We demonstrate high-dimensional entanglement with ≈ 6 qubits per photon via mode-locked biphoton frequency comb. Hong-Ou-Mandel quantum revival is observed with 61 time-bins and 99.8% visibility.

articleTitle: High-Temperature Continuous-Wave Operation of $1.3-\mu\text{m}$ Membrane Distributed Reflector Lasers on SiC
abstract: We demonstrate continuous-wave operation of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1.3-\mu\text{m}$</tex> membrane distributed reflector lasers on SiC at a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$130^{\text{o}}\text{C}$</tex> stage temperature. The laser, with its large thermal conductivity and optical confinement, is promising for high-temperature operation. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: A hybrid nanowire photo-detector integrated in a silicon photonic crystal
abstract: We demonstrate hybridization of silicon photonic crystals with single nanowires to create on-chip photo-detectors. The measured photo-current is enhanced by the photonic crystal optical antenna. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Transmission Nearfield Optical Microscopy (TNOM)of Photonic Crystal Bloch Modes
abstract: We utilize the stimulated quantized interaction of free electrons with femtosecond lasers to present the first direct subwavelength imaging of photonic crystal Bloch modes, also measuring the modes' lifetime and the entire photonic bandstructure. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High Energy Er:ZBLAN LMA Fiber Amplifier Producing ~200µJ and ~10ns Pulses at 2.72µm
abstract: Pulsed amplification at 2.7µm in Er:ZBLAN LMA fibers was explored demonstrating up to 194µJ in 9.7ns, the highest short-pulse energies from these mid-IR fibers. We also measured fiber damage threshold and 650µJ of stored energy. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Attosecond Relative Timing Jitter Between Optical Pulses and Rising Edges of Photocurrent Pulses
abstract: We characterize relative timing jitter between optical pulses and photocurrent pulses with 300-attosecond resolution. We found that excess timing jitter at the rising edge can show ultra-low ~400-attosecond-Ievel jitter for both p-i-n and MUTC photodiodes. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Magnetic Gauge Field for Photons in Synthetic Dimensions by a Propagation-Invariant Photonic Structure
abstract: We propose a system that exhibits an effective magnetic field for photons in synthetic - dimensions, implemented by a propagation-invariant (static) potential. The spectrum of this synthetic-space system displays Landau levels. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: High-Harmonic Generation from Topological Insulators
abstract: We report the observation of efficient high-harmonic generation in the three-dimensional topological insulators Bi2Se3 and Bi2Te3 driven by mid-infrared laser pulses of peak intensities ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: All-Time Single-Photon 3D Imaging Over 21 km
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate active three-dimensional (3D) imaging at a range of up to 21.6 km in daylight by constructing a high-efficiency single-photon LiDAR system and developing a long-range-tailored computational algorithm. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Catastrophic Degradation in High-Power Buried Heterostructure Quantum Cascade Lasers
abstract: Investigation of catastrophic degradation in high-power, buried-heterostructure quantum cascade lasers, using focused ion beam and high-resolution TEM techniques, has revealed dislocations generated, as a result of degradation, mostly in areas away from the active region. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Phase optimization of a silicon photonic two-dimensional electro-optic phased array
abstract: Phase errors in large optical phased arrays degrade beam quality and must be actively corrected. Using a novel, low-power electro-optic design with matched pathlengths, we demonstrate simplified optimization and reduced sensitivity to wavelength and temperature. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Flexible Pulse-Shape Picosecond Front-End for XFEL Photocathode Lasers
abstract: X-ray Free-Electron Lasers rely on low-emittance photo-injectors driven by UV laser pulses. For optimum performance temporally shaped laser pulses are desired. Here we present a laser front-end which delivers NIR ps-laser pulses of arbitrary pulse-envelope. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Ultra-Broadband Photonic Monopulse-Like Radar for Remote Sensing
abstract: High depth and transverse resolution remote target sensing using an extremely wide-bandwidth W-band (75 - 110 GHz) photonic monopulse-like radar system is demonstrated, offering prospects for millimeter wave 3-D sensing and imaging. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Thermo-Refractive Noise in Silicon Nitride Microresonators
abstract: Thermodynamic noises limit the frequency stability of resonators. Here, we present the first complete characterization of thermo-refractive noise in Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> microresonators. The measurements are in good agreement with theoretical analysis and FEM simulation of the structures. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Active $f$-To-$2f$ Interferometer for Record-Low Jitter Carrier-Envelope Phase Locking
abstract: Introduction of optical gain into the infrared arm of f-to-2f interferometers is demonstrated to improve signal-to-noise ratios by > 20 dB. This opens a perspective for CEP stabilization of unstabilizable lasers. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Training of Photonic Neural Networks through In Situ Backpropagation
abstract: We provide a protocol for training photonic neural networks based on adjoint methods. The gradient of the network with respect to its tunable degrees of freedom is computed by physically backpropagating an optical error signal. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Nanophotonic Integration of Atomic Wavelength References
abstract: Nanophotonic circuitry is interfaced to microfabricated alkali vapor cells forming a quantum sensing platform. We operate this device as a wavelength reference using several operation modes and discuss strengths and limitations of such devices. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: 50-Gb/S Dispersion-Unmanaged DMT Transmission with Injection Locked L0G-Class L.55-μm DML
abstract: We demonstrate 50-Gb/s DMT signal transmission over 20-km SMF by using a 10G-class 1.55-μm DML without optical dispersion compensation. Injection locking technique is introduced, which doubles system bandwidth and greatly suppresses DML chirp. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Spectrally Uniform Discrete Fourier Domain Mode Locked Fiber Laser by Time Domain Modulation
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a frequency domain linearized discrete Fourier domain mode locked laser with a rate varying pulse modulation in time domain. Discrete swept signal with an identical FSR of 100 GHz is demonstrated. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: The thermal sensitivity of optical path length in standard single mode fibers down to cryogenic temperatures
abstract: We measured the thermal sensitivity of SMF-28 fiber in the range −190°C-25°C and measured a > 3-fold decrease for uncoated fiber towards the lowest measured temperature and far higher sensitivities for coated and jacketed fibers. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: ~3.5 μm Self-Q-Switched Er3+:ZBLAN Fiber Laser Stabilized by an ASE Seeded Pump Source
abstract: We report on a ~3.5 µm highly stable self-Q-switched Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>+:ZBLAN fiber laser based on a temporally stable ASE seeded pump source. The pulsing dynamics are carefully investigated which can help facilitate their potential applications. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Joint OSNR, Skew, ROF Monitoring of Coherent Channel using Eye Diagram Measurement and Deep Learning
abstract: CNN-based deep learning is used to monitor coherent channel performance with eye diagram measurement. For 32GBd-QPSK signals, 99.57% prediction accuracy is achieved for 15 to 40dB OSNR, −15 to 15ps skew, 0.02 to 1 ROF.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Microscopy with Broadband Infrared Frequency Combs
abstract: We present a new modality for infrared, hyperspectral microscopy using dual-comb, electro-optic sampling of octave-spanning infrared frequency combs. We obtain hyperspectral images of SU8 test patterns on Si wafers with a spatial resolution of $12\ \mu \text{m}$.

articleTitle: Multi-orthogonal High-order Modes Converter
abstract: We demonstrate a fiber laser based on a cascaded AIFGs with flexible switching output of multiple modes <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(LP_{01}, LP_{11}^{even/odd}, LP_{21}^{even/odd}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$LP_{02})$</tex>. This has potential application in mode division multiplexing, multimode fiber laser. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Spectral-Efficient and High-Speed THz-wave Communication Using 40 Gsymbol/S Channel-Based Nyquist WDM
abstract: Nyquist WDM was adopted to improve spectral-efficiency and capacity of THz-wave communication. 2 × 40 Gbit/s Nyquist WDM communication in the THz-band was implemented, whose signal generation and reception were both assisted by optical processing. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Sequence-Coded Coherent Laser Range Finder
abstract: A range finder based on an extended sequence of coded pulses is demonstrated. Coherent detection is used to measure the range of weak point reflections, with average energy of only 0.15 photons per code symbol. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Single-Shot, Sub-Picometer-Resolution Wavemeter Using Topologically Enhanced Optical Activity of OAM Fiber Modes
abstract: We demonstrate an instantaneous wavelength-measurement technique with record resolution < 0.3pm at 1 μm wavelengths by exploiting the inherent circular birefringence of OAM fiber modes yielding giant tailorable optical activity. © 2019 The Authors

articleTitle: All-Fiber 2 μm Amplifier Using a Normal Dispersion Thulium Fiber
abstract: Normal dispersion thulium-doped fiber was deployed in all-fiber setup to amplify pulses from a near-2 μm ultrafast fiber cavity. We demonstrated >27 dB amplification gain to generate ~525nJ pulse energy at 1852nm without pulse breaking.© 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: An Optical Frequency Synthesizer Using an Integrated Erbium Tunable Laser
abstract: We demonstrate a self-calibrated optical frequency synthesizer using a fully-integrated erbium-doped tunable laser. A 20 nm tuning range from 1544 nm to 1564 nm is achieved with~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−13</sup> frequency instability at 10s averaging time. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Narrow Intrinsic Linewidth Frequency Combs from a Chip-Based Hybrid Integrated InP-Si3N4 Diode Laser

authors.preferredName: Peter J. M. Van der Slot

abstract: We present a hybrid integrated InP-Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> laser that generates frequency combs with a record-low intrinsic linewidth of 34 kHz. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Extreme Sub-wavelength Optical Confinement in Nanostructured All-dielectric Silicon Waveguides
abstract: Novel approaches for the design of all-dielectric silicon waveguides featuring strong field enhancement and low mode areas are presented. Deeply subwavelength transverse characteristics, previously limited to nano-plasmonic waveguides, are predicted in an all-dielectric platform. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Switching Light at the Interface Between Anomalous Floquet Topological Insulators
abstract: We study interface states at the boundary between two Anomalous Floquet Photonic Topological Insulators and show how their interactions with an edge mode can be used to switch it via the topological wave number. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Theoretical Investigation of a Si RRM Assisted SSB-OFDM Modulator Operated with a Semiconductor MLL
abstract: Performance of a transmitter with RRM-assisted SSB-OFDM modulator and semiconductor MLL is modeled. Phase noise related penalties arise even in back-to-back configuration and significantly modify the optimum RRM bias point.

articleTitle: Silicon Grating Coupler for Mode Order Conversion
abstract: A vertical silicon grating coupler that converts the propagation mode order at the waveguide-fiber interface was fabricated and characterized. Far-field intensity patterns are presented for different device configurations and the coupling efficiency is reported. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: On-Chip Backward Inter-Modal Brillouin Scattering
abstract: We present the first demonstration of backward stimulated Brillouin scattering between distinct guided optical spatial modes in an integrated multi-modal photonic circuit. This unique opto-acoustic process enables new opportunities for on-chip Brillouin signal processing technology. © 2019 The Author(s)

articleTitle: Quantum Science Experiments with Micius Satellite
abstract: The quantum science satellite have been launched successfully in China. Utilizing this satellite, we have completed a series of quantum experiments in space. Here, I will introduce these experiments and our future plans.

articleTitle: Absolute Distance Measurement with a Long Ambiguity Range Using a Tri-Comb Mode-Locked Fiber Laser
abstract: An absolute distance measurement scheme based on a single triple-comb mode-locked fiber laser is demonstrated. It can realize much longer ambiguity range for real-time measurement with a very simple fiber-optic system setup. © 2019 The Author(s)
